scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE [dbo].[PatronStg];

INSERT INTO [dbo].[PatronStg]
([PatronId], 
 [PatronName], 
 [Propertyname], 
 [PatronAddress1], 
 [PatronAddress2], 
 [PatronCity], 
 [PatronStateProvince], 
 [PatronCountry], 
 [PatronZipCode], 
 [LegacyPatronId], 
 [LegacyPatronAddressType], 
 [LegacyPatron]
)
       SELECT DISTINCT 
              [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
              TRIM(LEFT(x.[PatronName], 50)) AS [PatronName], 
              TRIM(x.[Propertyname]) AS [Propertyname], 
              TRIM(PatronAddress1) AS PatronAddress1, 
              TRIM(PatronAddress2) AS PatronAddress2, 
              TRIM(LEFT([PatronCity], 25)) AS [PatronCity], 
              TRIM([PatronStateProvince]) AS [PatronStateProvince],
              CASE [PatronCountry]
                  WHEN 'United States'
                  THEN 'US'
                  WHEN 'Canada'
                  THEN 'CA'
              END AS [PatronCountry], 
              TRIM(LEFT([PatronZipCode], 10)) AS [PatronZipCode], 
              TRIM(x.[LegacyPatronId]) AS [LegacyPatronId], 
              TRIM(x.[LegacyPatronAddressType]) AS [LegacyPatronAddressType], 
              TRIM(x.[Propertyname]) + '_' + TRIM(x.[LegacyPatronId]) + '_' + TRIM(x.[LegacyPatronAddressType]) AS [LegacyPatron]
       FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs] x;

MERGE [dbo].[Patron] AS tgt
USING [dbo].[PatronStg] AS src
ON src.patronid = tgt.patronid
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
    THEN
      INSERT([PatronId], 
             [PatronName], 
             [Propertyname], 
             [Address1], 
             [Address2], 
             [City], 
             [StateProvinceCode], 
             [Country], 
             [ZipCode], 
             [LegacyPatronId], 
             [LegacyPatronAddressType], 
             [LegacyPatron])
      VALUES
(src.[PatronId], 
 src.[PatronName], 
 src.[Propertyname], 
 src.[PatronAddress1], 
 src.[PatronAddress2], 
 src.[PatronCity], 
 src.[PatronStateProvince], 
 src.[PatronCountry], 
 src.[PatronZipCode], 
 src.[LegacyPatronId], 
 src.[LegacyPatronAddressType], 
 src.[LegacyPatron]
)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
    THEN DELETE;

TRUNCATE TABLE [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeStg];

INSERT INTO [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeStg]
([PatronId], 
 [ServiceTypeCode], 
 [Sku], 
 [CreditTermCode], 
 [CreditTermDescription], 
 [SapCustomerId], 
 [SapInterfaceType], 
 [SapMaterialCode]
)
       SELECT DISTINCT 
              [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
              x.[ServiceTypeCode], 
              '83FA0550-EF73-44CC-A21A-F88D1796B047' AS [Sku], 
              ct.[CreditTerm], 
              ct.[CreditTermDescription], 
              x.[SapCustomerId], 
              CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(4)) AS [SapInterfaceType],
              CASE x.[ServiceTypeCode]
                  WHEN 'IS'
                  THEN 'FR-NT15'
                  WHEN 'IF'
                  THEN 'FS-NT15'
              END AS [SapMaterialCode]
       FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs] x
            LEFT JOIN [dbo].[PatronInvoiceCreditTerms] ct ON ct.CrmOptionSetId = x.[CreditTermId];

MERGE [dbo].[PatronServiceType] AS tgt
USING [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeStg] AS src
ON src.patronid = tgt.patronid
   AND src.servicetypecode = tgt.servicetypecode
   AND src.[Sku] = tgt.[Sku]
   AND src.[CreditTermCode] = tgt.[CreditTermCode]
   AND src.[CreditTermDescription] = tgt.[CreditTermDescription]
   AND src.[SapCustomerId] = tgt.[SapCustomerId]
   AND src.[SapInterfaceType] = tgt.[SapInterfaceType]
   AND src.[SapMaterialCode] = tgt.[SapMaterialCode]
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
    THEN
      INSERT([PatronId], 
             [ServiceTypeCode], 
             [Sku], 
             [CreditTermCode], 
             [CreditTermDescription], 
             [SapCustomerId], 
             [SapInterfaceType], 
             [SapMaterialCode])
      VALUES
(src.[PatronId], 
 src.[ServiceTypeCode], 
 src.[Sku], 
 src.[CreditTermCode], 
 src.[CreditTermDescription], 
 src.[SapCustomerId], 
 src.[SapInterfaceType], 
 src.[SapMaterialCode]
)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
    THEN DELETE;

TRUNCATE TABLE [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeNotificationStg];

INSERT INTO [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeNotificationStg]
([PatronId], 
 [ServiceTypeCode], 
 [EmailAddress]
)
       SELECT DISTINCT 
              pe.PatronId, 
              pe.ServiceTypeCode, 
              pe.EmailAddress
       FROM
       (
           SELECT DISTINCT 
                  e.[PatronId], 
                  [ServiceTypeCode], 
                  [EmailAddress]
           FROM
           (
               SELECT DISTINCT 
                      [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
                      [ServiceTypeCode], 
                      customeremail1 AS [EmailAddress]
               FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs]
               WHERE ISNULL(customeremail1, '') <> ''
               UNION
               SELECT DISTINCT 
                      [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
                      [ServiceTypeCode], 
                      railroadinvoiceemail1 AS [EmailAddress]
               FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs]
               WHERE ISNULL(railroadinvoiceemail1, '') <> ''
               UNION
               SELECT DISTINCT 
                      [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
                      [ServiceTypeCode], 
                      watcoinvoiceemail1 AS [EmailAddress]
               FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs]
               WHERE ISNULL(watcoinvoiceemail1, '') <> ''
               UNION
               SELECT DISTINCT 
                      [PatronCode.watco_patroncodeid] AS [PatronId], 
                      [ServiceTypeCode], 
                      watco_invoice_primary_email_address AS [EmailAddress]
               FROM [dbo].[CrmXrefs]
               WHERE ISNULL(watco_invoice_primary_email_address, '') <> ''
           ) e
           WHERE EmailAddress <> ''
                 AND ServiceTypecode = 'IS'
       ) pe;

MERGE [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeNotification] AS tgt
USING [dbo].[PatronServiceTypeNotificationStg] AS src
ON src.patronid = tgt.patronid
   AND src.servicetypecode = tgt.servicetypecode
   AND src.emailaddress = tgt.emailaddress
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
    THEN
      INSERT([PatronId], 
             [ServiceTypeCode], 
             [EmailAddress])
      VALUES
(src.[PatronId], 
 src.[ServiceTypeCode], 
 src.[EmailAddress]
)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
    THEN DELETE;

  CASE WHEN M.move_datetime<'1/1/2000' THEN '' ELSE '1' END+CONVERT(CHAR(6),M.move_datetime,12) [EQH event date key],
  CAST(CAST(replace(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),M.move_datetime,8),':','') AS INT) AS VARCHAR(4)) [EQH event time key],
  CASE M.move_type_code WHEN 'BLG' THEN 'BADO' WHEN 'ICH' THEN 'ICHD' WHEN 'HRE' THEN 'OSTH' ELSE M.move_type_code END [EQH move typ key],
  '1' [Region ID],
  isnull(LT.WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION,'') [station ID],
  '1' [to RN ID key],
  T.WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION [to SN ID key],
  '' [ZN ID key],
  isnull(M.location,'') [LN ID key],
  isnull(M.fromto_road,'') Road,
  isnull(M.patron,'') [PD ID key],
  isnull(M.patron_addr_type,'') [patron address type],
  isnull(CAST(M.train_id AS VARCHAR(10)),'') [TRH train id key],
  '0' [TRH train control nbr key],
  '0' [TRH event date key],
  '0' [TRH event time key],
  '' [TRH move type key],
  '' [EQH intermodal status cd],
  '0' [EQH car hire extract date],
  '0' [EQH car hire extract time],
  'R' [EQH trans method cd],
  '0' [EQH convey WN control nbr],
  isnull(M.conveying_init,'') [EQH convey WE equip init],
  isnull(CAST(M.conveying_num AS CHAR(6)),'') [EQH convey WE equip nbr K],
  '0' [EQH spot date],
  '0' [EQH spot time],
  CAST(isnull(M.train_seq_num,M.location_seq_num) AS CHAR(6)) [EQH train seq],
  isnull(E.CHASSIS_INIT,'') [EQH chassis init],
  isnull(CAST(E.CHASSIS_NUM AS CHAR(6)),'0') [EQH chassis nbr],
  '' [EQH intermodal trip ind],
  SUBSTRING(M.mod_by,1,8) [STR user ID],
  CASE WHEN M.mod_datetime<'1/1/2000' THEN '' ELSE '1' END+CONVERT(CHAR(6),M.mod_datetime,12) [STR date entered],
  CAST(replace(CONVERT(CHAR(5),M.mod_datetime,8),':','') AS CHAR(4)) [STR time entered],
  isnull(SUBSTRING(CAST(E.weight AS CHAR(20)),1,9),'0') weight,
  isnull(E.weight_qual,'') [WE N704 weight qual],
  isnull(CAST(tare_wt AS CHAR(9)),'0') [tare weight],
  '0' [weight allowance],
  '' [tare qual],
  '' equipmenthistoryID FROM eqmt_movement_history M WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN waybill W WITH (nolock) ON M.rtex_road_id=W.rtex_road_id
     AND M.waybill_cntl_num=W.waybill_cntl_num
     AND isnull(M.delete_ind,'')='' INNER JOIN wb_eqmt E WITH (nolock) ON E.rtex_road_id=M.rtex_road_id
    AND E.waybill_cntl_num=M.waybill_cntl_num
    AND E.eqmt_init=M.eqmt_init
    AND E.eqmt_num=M.eqmt_num INNER JOIN wb_watss WW WITH (nolock) ON WW.rtex_road_id=M.rtex_road_id
     AND WW.waybill_cntl_num=M.waybill_cntl_num
     AND WW.eqmt_init=M.eqmt_init
     AND WW.eqmt_num=M.eqmt_num INNER JOIN umler U ON M.eqmt_init=U.eqmt_init
    AND M.eqmt_num=U.eqmt_num LEFT JOIN(SELECT INFOMoveTypeCode,
  MAX(RS4000MoveTypeCode) RS4000MoveTypeCode FROM movecode GROUP BY INFOMoveTypeCode) movecode ON M.move_type_code=INFOMoveTypeCode LEFT JOIN station T ON M.rtex_road_id=T.road_id
     AND M.fsac=T.fsac LEFT JOIN eqmt_movement_history MH WITH (nolock) ON M.rtex_road_id=MH.rtex_road_id
     AND M.waybill_cntl_num=MH.waybill_cntl_num
     AND M.eqmt_init=MH.eqmt_init
     AND M.eqmt_num=MH.eqmt_num
     AND M.MOVE_DATETIME>MH.move_datetime
     AND M.move_type_code<>'ICR' LEFT JOIN station LT ON MH.rtex_road_id=LT.road_id
  AND MH.fsac=LT.fsac WHERE(M.DELETE_IND IS NULL
   OR M.DELETE_IND<>'Y')
  AND CAST(M.mod_datetime AS DATE)>=CAST(DATEADD(day,-10,GETDATE()) AS DATE)
  AND RS4000MoveTypeCode IS NULL
  AND (MH.MOVE_DATETIME IS NULL
  OR MH.MOVE_DATETIME=(SELECT MAX(Move_datetime) lastMoveDT FROM EQMT_MOVEMENT_HISTORY WITH (nolock) WHERE M.rtex_road_id=rtex_road_id
  AND M.waybill_cntl_num=waybill_cntl_num
  AND M.eqmt_init=eqmt_init
  AND M.eqmt_num=eqmt_num
  AND MOVE_DATETIME<M.MOVE_DATETIME

, ec.IsoCurrencyCode, ec.PaymentMethod, ec.ChargeRate, ec.ChargeTotal, ec.ChargeDatetime, ec.Billable, ec.Obsolete 
, ecp.EquipmentInitial, ecp.EquipmentNumber, ecp.EquipmentStatus, ecp.EquipmentWeight, ecp.InvoicedCif, ecp.PriceAuthorityAgency
, ecp.PriceAuthorityItem, ecp.PriceAuthorityNumber, ecp.RatedDatetime, ecp.RoadMark, ecp.ServicedCif, ecp.ServiceTypeName, ecp.SettlementDate

FROM [dbo].[EstimatedCharge] ec JOIN

Select cast(isnull(C.[waybill_cntl_num],0)  as numeric(9,0)) [Waybill]
       ,C.[eqmt_init] [Init]
	   ,cast(C.[eqmt_num]  as numeric(6,0)) [Nbr]
       ,[seq_num] [SeqNbrKey]
       ,cast(Case When C.[chrg_date]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1'
        End + CONVERT(CHAR(10), C.[chrg_date], 12)  as numeric(7,0)) [EventDate]
       ,CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(5), C.[chrg_date], 8), ':', '') As numeric(4,0)) [EventTime]
       ,ISNULL(Case M.[move_type_code]
                 When 'BLG' Then 'BADO'
                 When 'ICH' Then 'ICHD'
                 When 'HRE' Then 'OSTH'
                 Else Rs4000movetypecode
               End, '') [MoveType]
       ,C.[chrg_code] [ChargeCd]
       ,substring(Case When C.[patron_road_ind]='R' Then isnull(C.[chrg_party],'') Else '' End,1,4) [RDIDKEY]
       ,Case When C.[patron_road_ind]<>'R' Then C.[chrg_party] Else '' End   [Patron]
       ,C.[chrg_party_addr_type] [AddrType]
       ,substring(isnull(SR.[serv_type_code],C.[serv_type_code]),1,30) [ICReference]
       ,isnull(substring(replace(substring(ISNULL(SR.[watss_serv_code],C.[watss_serv_code]),1,2),'1',''),1,2),'') [UTTypeServiceCd]
       ,isnull(substring(C.[chrg_desc],1,30),'') [ICDescription]
       ,'1' [RNIDKEY]
       ,isnull([WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION],'') [StationID]
       ,cast([bill_amt]  as numeric(9,2)) [BillAmount]
       ,'W' [SourceOfData]
       ,Case When X.[min_amt] = [bill_amt] Then 'Y' Else '' End [MinimumAmtUsed]
       ,isnull(cast(Case When C.[chrg_date]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(10), C.[chrg_date], 12) as numeric(7,0)),0) [DateBilled]
       ,isnull([inv_num],0)  [InvoiceNbr]
       ,cast(Year(C.[chrg_date]) as char(4))+right('00'+cast(Month(C.[chrg_date]) as varchar(2)),2) [AccountingPeriod]
       ,'' [ChargeAdjustmentCd]
       ,'USD' [CurrencyCd]
       ,'' [ExtractedToSuperTrip]
       ,'' [IncInSupertripInd]
       ,'Y' [AccountingExtractFlg]
       ,'' [SuppressExtractToCA]
       ,isnull(cast(Case When [SENT_TO_ACCOUNTING_DATE]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(10), [SENT_TO_ACCOUNTING_DATE], 12)  as numeric(7,0)),0) [DateInvoicePrinted]
       ,isnull(C.[RECLAIM_CODE],0) [ReclaimCode]
       ,'' [Unused15Char]
       ,[invoice_letter] [InvoiceType]
       ,substring([serv_type_group],1,1) [ServiceGroupCd]
       ,Case When inv_status = 'C' Then 2 Else 1 End [InvoiceRevision]
       ,Case When inv_status = 'D' Then 'V' Else '' End [VoidFlag]
       ,cast(0   as numeric(9,2)) [ChargeAdjustmentPct]
       ,cast(0   as numeric(9,2)) [PercentWeightToCharge]
       ,'' [Direct/IndirectInd]
       ,cast([bill_amt]  as numeric(9,2)) [TotalAmount]
       ,cast(0 as int) [IMBSequenceNbr]
       ,cast(ISNULL([num_of_cars],0) as int) [Quantity]
       ,'' [HoldFlag]
       ,'' [TypeICM/DEM]
       ,cast(0   as numeric(7,0)) [PaymentDueDate]
       ,'' [IMBTypeInvoiceRun]
       ,'' [TariffInfo]
       ,substring(Case When inv_status = 'D' Then C.mod_by Else '' End,1,8)             [VoidUserID]
       ,cast(Case When inv_status = 'D' Then Case When C.[mod_datetime]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(10), C.[mod_datetime], 12) Else 0 End  as numeric(7,0)) [VoidDate]
       ,Case When inv_status = 'D' Then cast(replace(convert(char(5), C.[mod_datetime], 8),':','') as numeric(4,0)) Else 0 End [VoidTime]
       ,Case When inv_status = 'D' Then cast(Year(C.[mod_datetime]) as char(4))+right('00'+cast(Month(C.[mod_datetime]) as varchar(2)),2) Else 0 End [VoidAccountingPeriod]
       ,isnull(isnull(SR.[authority_type],X.[authority_type]),'') [PI01PriceAuthID]
       ,isnull(isnull(SR.[Authority_Number],X.[Authority_Number]),'') [PI02PriceAuthority]
       ,isnull(isnull(SR.[authority_agency],X.[authority_agency]),'') [PI05SCAC]
       ,isnull(isnull(SR.[authority_item],X.[authority_item]),'') [PI08TariffItemNbr]
       ,isnull([acct_num],'') [GLAccountNumber]
       ,isnull([acct_code] ,'') [GLCostCenter]
       ,0 [InvoicePageNbr]
       ,0 [InvoiceLineNbr]
       ,'' [SalesTaxCode]
       ,substring(C.mod_by,1,8) [BilledUserID]
       ,'' [Unused1Byte02]
       ,'' [Unused1Byte03]
       ,'' [Unused1Byte04]
       ,'' [Unused1Byte05]
       ,'' [Unused2Byte01]
       ,'' [Unused2Byte02]
       ,substring(C.[mod_by],1,8) [UserIDModified]
       ,cast(case when C.[mod_datetime]<'1/1/2000' Then '' else '1' end ++convert(char(10), C.[mod_datetime], 12) as numeric(7,0))  [DateModified]
       ,cast(replace(convert(char(5), C.[mod_datetime], 8),':','') as numeric(4,0))  [TimeModified]
       ,C.[rtex_road_id] [Railroad]
       ,GETDATE() [LoadedDateTime]
  From [vw_Charges_All] C
       Inner Join [serv_type_code] S
         On C.[rtex_road_id]=S.[rtex_road_id]
            And C.[serv_type_code]=S.[serv_type_code]
       Left Join [chrg_template] X
         On C.[rtex_road_id]=X.[rtex_road_id]
            And C.[chrg_code]=X.[chrg_code]
            And C.[chrg_date] between [EFF_DATE] and [EXP_DATE]
	   Left Join [surcharge] SR
		 On C.[RTEX_ROAD_ID] = SR.[RTEX_ROAD_ID]
			and C.[CHRG_CODE] = SR.[SURCHARGE_CODE]
			and cast(cast(C.[datetime] as date) as datetime) between SR.[EFF_DATE] and SR.[EXP_DATE]
       Left Join [eqmt_movement_history] M
         On C.[rtex_road_id]=M.[rtex_road_id]
            And C.[eqmt_init]=M.[eqmt_init]
            And C.[eqmt_num]=M.[eqmt_num]
            And C.[chrg_date]=[move_datetime]	and ISNULL(M.DELETE_IND,'') <> 'Y'
       Left Join (Select Infomovetypecode,MAX(Rs4000movetypecode) Rs4000movetypecode
                    From [movecode] Group By Infomovetypecode) [movecode]
         On M.[move_type_code]=Infomovetypecode
       Left Join [station] T
         On C.[rtex_road_id]=T.[road_id]
            And C.[fsac]=T.[fsac]
WHERE  (ISNULL(C.[inv_status],'') <> 'D')
 and  CAST(C.[chrg_date] AS DATE) < CAST(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '/' + 
								 					CAST(MONTH(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) AS VARCHAR(2)) + '/01' AS DATE)
       and cast(C.[chrg_date] as date) >= CAST(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '/' + 
								 					CAST(MONTH(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AS VARCHAR(2)) + '/01' AS DATE)

) id on id.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
join PatronCharge pc on pc.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
join (select pc.ChargeId,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentInitial'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentInitial,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentStatus'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentStatus,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentWeight'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentWeight,
min(case propertyname when ''InvoicedCif'' then propertyvalue end) as InvoicedCif,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityAgency'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityAgency,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityItem'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityItem,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''RatedDatetime'' then propertyvalue end) as RatedDatetime,
min(case propertyname when ''RoadMark'' then propertyvalue end) as RoadMark,
min(case propertyname when ''ServicedCif'' then propertyvalue end) as ServicedCif,
min(case propertyname when ''ServiceTypeName'' then propertyvalue end) as ServiceTypeName,
min(case propertyname when ''SettlementDate'' then propertyvalue end) as SettlementDate,
min(case propertyname when ''Stcc'' then propertyvalue end) as Stcc,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionType'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionType,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionVolumeQuantity'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionVolumeQuantity,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionVolumeUom'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionVolumeUom,
min(case propertyname when ''UrrwinNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as UrrwinNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillDateTime'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillDateTime,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''PreviousInvoiceId'' then propertyvalue end) as PreviousInvoiceId,
min(case propertyname when ''RevenueMovementDateTime'' then propertyvalue end) as RevenueMovementDateTime
  FROM [dbo].[PatronInvoice] i
  JOIN [dbo].[PatronCharge] pc on pc.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  join [dbo].[PatronChargeProperty] pcp on pcp.ChargeId = pc.ChargeId
  group by i.InvoiceId, pc.ChargeId) cd on cd.ChargeId = pc.ChargeId
  where ShortId = ''', variables('loopIHREZ'), ''' and  i.[IssuingPartyName] = ''', variables('loopRoadId'), ''' and i.InvoiceId = ( select top 1 InvoiceId
                      from PatronInvoice
                      where ShortId = ''',variables('loopIHREZ'),''' order by [Version] desc
)')

    ,stg.[Addr_Type] Addr_Type
    ,stg.[Reportable] Reportable
    ,'I' Change_Code
    ,stg.[Mod_By] Mod_By
    ,stg.[Mod_Datetime] Mod_Datetime
  FROM [Staging].[Fleet] stg 
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Fleet_Master] fm

  WHERE fm.Fleet_Name IS NULL

      ,[PriceAuthorityAgency]
      ,[PriceAuthorityItem]
      ,[PriceAuthorityNumber]
      ,[RatedDatetime]
      ,[ServiceTypeName]
      ,[SettlementDate]
      ,[Stcc]
      ,[TransactionType]
      ,[TransactionVolumeQuantity]
      ,[TransactionVolumeUom]
      ,[UrrwinNumber]
      ,[RevenueMovementDateTime] from PatronInvoice i
join (
select i.invoiceid,
min(case propertyname when ''BillOfLadingDatetime'' then propertyvalue end) as BillOfLadingDatetime,
min(case propertyname when ''BillOfLadingNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as BillOfLadingNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''Destination'' then propertyvalue end) as Destination,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentCount'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentCount,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentWeightInPounds'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentWeightInPounds,
min(case propertyname when ''LeadCarInitial'' then propertyvalue end) as LeadCarInitial,
min(case propertyname when ''LeadCarNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as LeadCarNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''Multicar'' then propertyvalue end) as Multicar,
min(case propertyname when ''Origin'' then propertyvalue end) as Origin,
min(case propertyname when ''PatronAddressType'' then propertyvalue end) as PatronAddressType,
min(case propertyname when ''PatronId'' then propertyvalue end) as PatronId,
min(case propertyname when ''PlantNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as PlantNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''RoadMark'' then propertyvalue end) as RoadMark,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillDate'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillDate,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillNumber
from PatronInvoice i
join PatronInvoiceProperty pip on pip.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
group by i.InvoiceId
) id on id.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
join PatronCharge pc on pc.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
join (select pc.ChargeId,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentInitial'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentInitial,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentStatus'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentStatus,
min(case propertyname when ''EquipmentWeight'' then propertyvalue end) as EquipmentWeight,
min(case propertyname when ''InvoicedCif'' then propertyvalue end) as InvoicedCif,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityAgency'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityAgency,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityItem'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityItem,
min(case propertyname when ''PriceAuthorityNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as PriceAuthorityNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''RatedDatetime'' then propertyvalue end) as RatedDatetime,
min(case propertyname when ''RoadMark'' then propertyvalue end) as RoadMark,
min(case propertyname when ''ServicedCif'' then propertyvalue end) as ServicedCif,
min(case propertyname when ''ServiceTypeName'' then propertyvalue end) as ServiceTypeName,
min(case propertyname when ''SettlementDate'' then propertyvalue end) as SettlementDate,
min(case propertyname when ''Stcc'' then propertyvalue end) as Stcc,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionType'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionType,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionVolumeQuantity'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionVolumeQuantity,
min(case propertyname when ''TransactionVolumeUom'' then propertyvalue end) as TransactionVolumeUom,
min(case propertyname when ''UrrwinNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as UrrwinNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillDateTime'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillDateTime,
min(case propertyname when ''WaybillNumber'' then propertyvalue end) as WaybillNumber,
min(case propertyname when ''PreviousInvoiceId'' then propertyvalue end) as PreviousInvoiceId,
min(case propertyname when ''RevenueMovementDateTime'' then propertyvalue end) as RevenueMovementDateTime
  FROM [dbo].[PatronInvoice] i
  JOIN [dbo].[PatronCharge] pc on pc.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  join [dbo].[PatronChargeProperty] pcp on pcp.ChargeId = pc.ChargeId
  group by i.InvoiceId, pc.ChargeId) cd on cd.ChargeId = pc.ChargeId
  where ShortId = ''', variables('loopIHREZ'), ''' and  i.[IssuingPartyName] = ''', variables('loopRoadId'), '''')

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT  r.Road_ID, 
       r.Server_Name, 
       r.WATSS_Database_Name
FROM [dbo].[Watco_Roads] r
     JOIN [dbo].[Watco_Roads_Property] p ON p.[Road_Id] = r.[Road_Id]
WHERE r.[Server_Name] IS NOT NULL
      AND [InventoryFlag] = 1;

Select distinct																								
	   S.[rtex_road_id]                              [client road]																							
       ,cast(S.[waybill_cntl_num] as decimal(18,0))  [control number]																								
       ,S.[eqmt_init]                                [equipment initial]																								
       ,cast(S.[eqmt_num] as decimal(18,0))          [equipment number]																								
       ,isnull(cast(W.[waybill_num] as decimal(18,0)),0) [waybill number]																								
       ,isnull(CONVERT(CHAR(8), W.[waybill_date], 112),0) [waybill date]																								
       ,S.[eqmt_status_code]                         [l/e status]																								
       ,U.[aar_car_type]                             [aar car type]																								
       ,case when isnull(Fleet_Name,'') = '' then substring(U.[aar_car_type],1,1) else substring(isnull(Fleet_Name,''),1,3) end                      [equipment kind]																								
       ,isnull(right('0000' + cast([stcc] as varchar(10)),7),'0')      [stcc]																								
       ,isnull(substring(ST.[commodity],1,25),'')	 [commodity description]																			
       ,T.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION]				 [station ID]																			
       ,''  										 [zone ID]														
       ,S.[location]								 [track id]																
       ,isnull(substring(L.Name,1,25),'')			 [location comment]														
       ,isnull(cast(S.[train_id] as varchar(25)),'') [train id]																								
       ,isnull(cast(S.[train_seq_num] as int),S.[location_seq_num]) [track/train position]																								
       ,isnull(A.[Block_to_id],'')					 [block to ID key]																		
       ,isnull(A.[Block_to_addr],'')				 [block to address type]																				
       ,isnull(cast(E.[weight] as decimal(18,0)),0)	 [weight]																							
       ,E.[weight_qual]								 [weight type]																
       ,isnull(cast([tare_wt] as decimal(18,0)),0)   [tare weight]																								
       ,isnull(U.[outside_lth],0)                    [length]																								
       ,case when isnull(S.[BAD_ORDER_REASON_CODE],'') = '' then '' else 'Y' end [bad order indicator]																								
       ,isnull(substring(O.[station_name],1,25),'')	 [origin city]																			
       ,isnull(O.[state_province_code],'')			 [origin state]																					
       ,isnull(substring(D.[station_name],1,25),'')	 [destination city]																			
       ,isnull(D.[state_province_code],'')			 [destination state]																					
       ,isnull(substring(SH.[patron_name],1,25),'')	 [shipper name]																			
       ,isnull(substring(CN.[patron_name],1,25),'')	 [consignee name]																			
       ,case when isnull(R.[RWC_TYPE],'') = '1' then 'T' else 'P' end [inbound/outbound indicator]																								
       ,case when S.[rtex_road_id] <> A.[WATSS_FROM_ROAD]	then A.[WATSS_FROM_ROAD] else case when S.[rtex_road_id] <> A.[WATSS_TO_ROAD] then A.[WATSS_TO_ROAD] else '' end end [connecting road]																							
       ,CONVERT(CHAR(8), S.[rec_datetime], 112)	 [received date]																							
       ,cast(replace(convert(char(5), S.[rec_datetime], 8),':','') as varchar(8)) [received time]																								
       ,CASE LST.[move_type_code] WHEN 'BLG' THEN 'BADO' WHEN 'ICH' THEN 'ICHD' WHEN 'HRE' THEN 'OSTH' ELSE ISNULL(last.RS4000MoveTypeCode,S.[move_type_code]) END [last move type]																	
       ,isnull(substring(W.[special_instructions],1,25),'')			 [special instructions]																					
       ,isnull(W.[orig_fsac],0)						 [origin FSAC]																		
       ,isnull(W.[dest_fsac],0)						 [destination FSAC]																		
       ,isnull(CONVERT(CHAR(8), PAC.[move_datetime], 112),0)	 [placement date]																							
       ,isnull(cast(replace(convert(char(5), PAC.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int),0) [placement time]																								
       ,isnull(CN.[patron_ID],'')					 [consignee ID]																			
       ,isnull(CN.[patron_addr_type],'')			 [consignee address type]																					
       ,isnull(SH.[patron_ID],'')					 [shipper ID]																			
       ,isnull(SH.[patron_addr_type],'')			 [shipper address type]																					
       ,isnull(W.[online_patron_ID],'')				 [customer ID]																				
       ,isnull(W.[online_patron_addr_type],'')		 [customer address type]																						
       ,isnull(A.[Haulage_Ind],'')                   [switch/haulage indicator]																								
       ,isnull(A.[haulage_road],'')					 [haulage road]																			
       ,CONVERT(CHAR(8), LST.[move_datetime], 112)	 [last move date]																							
       ,cast(replace(convert(char(5), S.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int) [last move time]																								
       ,[waybill_type]                               [traffic type]																								
       ,case when S.[rec_datetime] <> 0 then (DATEDIFF(hour, S.[rec_datetime],GETDATE()))/24 else 0 end [days online]																								
       ,0											 [daily car hire rate]													
       ,isnull(cast(CONVERT(CHAR(8), PCO.[move_datetime], 112) as decimal(18,0)),0) [constructive placement date]																								
       ,isnull(cast(replace(convert(char(5), PCO.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int),0) [constructive placement time]																								
       ,isnull(cast(CONVERT(CHAR(8), RLS.[move_datetime], 112) as decimal(18,0)),0) [release date]																								
       ,isnull(cast(replace(convert(char(5), RLS.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int),0) [release time]																								
       ,0											 [milepost]													
       ,case when S.[rtex_road_id] in (U.[lessee_mark],U.[owner_mark]) or S.[eqmt_init] = 'WAMX' or 																								
			(len(S.[eqmt_init]) = 4 and substring(S.[eqmt_init],1,4) = 'X' and S.[rtex_road_id] not in (U.[lessee_mark],U.[owner_mark])) 																					
			then 'Y' else 'N' end [system car]																					
	   ,case when S.[move_type_code] in ('STA','STI','STN','STP','STS','STU')	 then 'Y' else '' end  [storage indicator]																						
	   ,case when U.OWNERSHIP_CODE IN ('N','O','P','Q') or (len(S.[eqmt_init]) = 4 and substring(S.[eqmt_init],1,4) = 'X' and U.[owner_mark] = 'TTX') THEN 'P' else 'F' end [foreign/private/ttx]																					
	   ,[pymt_method_code]							 [method of payment]																
	   ,'R'											 [transportation method code]												
	   ,''											 [product group code]												
	   ,substring([bill_of_lading_num],1,25)		 [BOL number]																	
       ,isnull(A.[watss_dest],'')					 [STS - Station]																			
       ,isnull([st_track],'')						 [STS - track]																		
       ,isnull([st_spot],'')						 [STS - spot]																		
       ,isnull(A.[switch_to_id],'')					 [switch to ID]																			
       ,isnull(A.[switch_to_addr],'')				 [switch to address type] 																				
       ,case S.[MOVE_TYPE_CODE] when 'PAC' then 'AP' when 'PCO' then 'CP' else case when S.[MOVE_TYPE_CODE] in ('STA','STI','STN','STP','STS','STU') then 'TS' 																								
			else case when not isnull(S.HOLD_REASON_CODE,'') = '' then 'RP' 																					
			else case when not isnull(S.BAD_ORDER_REASON_CODE,'') = '' then 'TS' else 'SW' end end end end [activityind]																					
       ,''											 [weigh car indicator]													
       ,''											 [serving station]													
       ,isnull(substring([dest_online],1,25),'')	 [priority special handling code]																					
       ,cast(S.[location_seq_num] as varchar(25))	 [current spot]																							
       ,[Rec_station]								 [rec trip station]																
       ,[load_limit]								 [load limit]																
       ,cast([assign_pool_num] as varchar(25))		 [pool code]																						
       ,[owner_mark]								 [owner mark]																
       ,[lessee_mark]								 [lessee]																
       ,''											 [clearance code]													
       ,isnull([cubic_capacity],0)					 [cubic feet capacity]																			
       ,S.[rtex_road_id]							 [controlling road]																	
       ,case when CS.[move_datetime] Is null then 0 else DATEDIFF(hour, CS.[move_datetime],GETDATE()) end [hours at station]																								
       ,''											 [reclaim code]													
       ,''											 [reclaim ID]													
       ,''											 [car hire ind]													
       ,isnull(CONVERT(CHAR(8), STA.[move_datetime], 112),'0') [into storage date]																								
       ,isnull(cast(replace(convert(char(5), STA.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int),0) [into storage time]																								
       ,isnull(CONVERT(CHAR(8), HRE.[move_datetime], 112),0) [out of storage date]																								
       ,isnull(cast(replace(convert(char(5), HRE.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int),0) [out of storage time]																								
       ,CONVERT(CHAR(8), S.[mod_datetime], 112)	 [create date]																							
       ,cast(replace(convert(char(5), S.[mod_datetime], 8),':','') as int) [create time]																								
        																								
  From [eqmt_status] S																								
       Inner Join [waybill] W																								
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=W.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[waybill_cntl_num]=W.[waybill_cntl_num]																								
       Inner Join [wb_eqmt] E																								
         On E.[rtex_road_id]=S.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And E.[waybill_cntl_num]=S.[waybill_cntl_num]																								
            And E.[eqmt_init]=S.[eqmt_init]																								
            And E.[eqmt_num]=S.[eqmt_num]																								
       LEFT Join [umler] U																								
         On S.[eqmt_init]=U.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=U.[eqmt_num]
       LEFT Join (select INFOMoveTypeCode, MAX(RS4000MoveTypeCode) RS4000MoveTypeCode from [movecode] group by INFOMoveTypeCode) [movecode]
		 ON S.[move_type_code] = INFOMoveTypeCode																								
        Left Join [rwc_watss] R																								
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=R.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And W.[rwc_code]=R.[rwc_code]																								
       Left Join [wb_watss] A																								
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=A.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[waybill_cntl_num]=A.[waybill_cntl_num]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=A.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=A.[eqmt_num]																								
       Left Join [stcc] ST																								
         On S.[stcc]=ST.[stcc_code]																								
       Inner Join [station] T																								
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=T.[road_id]																								
			And S.[fsac]=T.[fsac]
	   Left Join [location] L
		 On S.[rtex_road_id]=L.[rtex_road_id]																								
			And S.[fsac]=L.[fsac] 
			And S.[location] = L.[location_id]																					
	   Left Join [station] O																							
	     On W.[orig_road]=O.[road_id]																							
			And W.[orig_fsac]=O.[fsac] And W.[orig_fsac] <> 0																					
	   Left Join [station] D																							
	     On W.[dest_road]=D.[road_id]																							
			And W.[dest_fsac]=D.[fsac] And W.[dest_fsac] <> 0																					
	   Left Join (SELECT [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[RTEX_ROAD_ID]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[TYPE_OF_PARTY]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_ID]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_ADDR_TYPE]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_NAME]
				  FROM [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES] 
					JOIN (SELECT [RTEX_ROAD_ID],[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM],MAX([WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]) [SEQ_NUM]
							  FROM [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES] WHERE [type_of_party] = 'CN' 
							  GROUP BY [RTEX_ROAD_ID],[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]) x 
						ON [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[RTEX_ROAD_ID]=x.[RTEX_ROAD_ID] and [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]=x.[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM] 
							and [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]=x.[SEQ_NUM]) CN																							
	     On W.[rtex_road_id]=CN.[rtex_road_id]																							
			And W.[waybill_cntl_num]=CN.[waybill_cntl_num]																																										
	   Left Join (SELECT [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[RTEX_ROAD_ID]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[TYPE_OF_PARTY]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_ID]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_ADDR_TYPE]
					  ,[WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[PATRON_NAME]
				  FROM [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES] 
					JOIN (SELECT [RTEX_ROAD_ID],[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM],MAX([WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]) [SEQ_NUM]
							  FROM [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES] WHERE [type_of_party] = 'SH' And [patron_name] <> 'DELIVERY SWITCH' and [patron_name] <> 'AGENT' 
							  GROUP BY [RTEX_ROAD_ID],[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]) x 
						ON [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[RTEX_ROAD_ID]=x.[RTEX_ROAD_ID] and [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM]=x.[WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM] 
							and [WB_ASSOC_PARTIES].[SEQ_NUM]=x.[SEQ_NUM]) SH																							
	     On W.[rtex_road_id]=SH.[rtex_road_id]																							
			And W.[waybill_cntl_num]=SH.[waybill_cntl_num]																																										
	   Left Join [patron] P																							
	     On W.[rtex_road_id]=P.[rtex_road_id]																							
			And W.[online_patron_id]=P.[patron_id]																					
			And W.[online_patron_addr_type]=P.[addr_type]																					
	    Left Join [eqmt_trip_cycle] TC																								
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=TC.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=TC.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=TC.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=TC.[trip_cycle_num]																								
       Left Join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num], max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) where [move_type_code] = 'PAC' and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																				
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] > (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 											
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('RMT','RLO','RLS','ICR','ZBL') 
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')											
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num]																			
					) PAC																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=PAC.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=PAC.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=PAC.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=PAC.[trip_cycle_num]																								
       Left Join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num], max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) where [move_type_code] = 'PCO' and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																				
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] > (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 										
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('RMT','RLO','RLS','ICR','ZBL') 
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')											
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num]																			
					) PCO																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=PCO.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=PCO.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=PCO.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=PCO.[trip_cycle_num]																								
       Left Join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num], max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) where [move_type_code] in ('RMT','RLO','RLS') and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																				
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] > (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 										
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('ICR','ZBL') 
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')											
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num]																			
					) RLS																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=RLS.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=RLS.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=RLS.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=RLS.[trip_cycle_num]																								
       Left Join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num], min([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) where [move_type_code] in ('STA','STI','STN','STP','STS','STU') and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																			
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] > (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 										
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('RMT','RLO','RLS','ICR','ZBL') 
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')											
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num]																			
					) STA																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=STA.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=STA.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=STA.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=STA.[trip_cycle_num]																								
		Left Join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num], max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																						
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) where [move_type_code] = 'HRE' and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																			
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] > (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 										
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('RMT','RLO','RLS','ICR','ZBL','STA','STI','STN','STP','STS','STU')
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')	 										
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num]																			
					) HRE																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=HRE.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=HRE.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=HRE.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=HRE.[trip_cycle_num]																								
        Left Join (select x.[rtex_road_id], x.[eqmt_init], x.[eqmt_num], x.[trip_cycle_num], [WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION] [Rec_station], max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) Inner Join [STATION] y 																			
						ON x.[rtex_road_id]=y.[road_id]																		
							And x.[fsac]=y.[fsac]																	
						inner join (select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num] 																		
										from [eqmt_trip_cycle] 														
											where [close_datetime] is null) z													
						on x.[rtex_road_id]=z.[rtex_road_id]																		
							And x.[eqmt_init]=z.[eqmt_init]																	
							And x.[eqmt_num]=z.[eqmt_num]																	
							And x.[trip_cycle_num]=z.[trip_cycle_num]																	
						where [move_type_code] in ('ICR','ZBL')	and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																		
						And x.[MOVE_DATETIME] = (select max([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] T with (nolock) 										
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=T.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=T.[eqmt_init]										
														And x.[eqmt_num]=T.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=T.[trip_cycle_num]										
														And [move_type_code] in ('ICR','ZBL') 
														and (T.delete_ind is null or T.delete_ind <> 'Y')											
													group by [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num])											
					group by x.[rtex_road_id], x.[eqmt_init], x.[eqmt_num], x.[trip_cycle_num], [WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION]																			
					) REC																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=REC.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=REC.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=REC.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=REC.[trip_cycle_num]																								
       Left Join (select x.[rtex_road_id], x.[eqmt_init], x.[eqmt_num], x.[trip_cycle_num], [fsac], min([move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) inner join 
							(select [rtex_road_id], [eqmt_init], [eqmt_num], [trip_cycle_num] 																			
							  from [eqmt_trip_cycle] where [close_datetime] is null) z				
						on x.[rtex_road_id]=z.[rtex_road_id]																		
							And x.[eqmt_init]=z.[eqmt_init]																	
							And x.[eqmt_num]=z.[eqmt_num]																	
							And x.[trip_cycle_num]=z.[trip_cycle_num]
					where (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																	
					group by x.[rtex_road_id], x.[eqmt_init], x.[eqmt_num], x.[trip_cycle_num], [fsac]																			
					) CS																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=CS.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=CS.[eqmt_init]																								
            And S.[eqmt_num]=CS.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=CS.[trip_cycle_num]																								
            And S.[fsac] = CS.[fsac]																								
            And S.[move_datetime] = CS.[move_datetime]
       Left Join (select distinct x.[rtex_road_id], x.[eqmt_init], x.[eqmt_num], x.[trip_cycle_num], x.[move_type_code], x.[move_datetime]																								
					from [eqmt_movement_history] x with (nolock) 
						inner join [eqmt_trip_cycle] z	on x.[rtex_road_id]=z.[rtex_road_id]																		
							And x.[eqmt_init]=z.[eqmt_init]	And x.[eqmt_num]=z.[eqmt_num]																	
							And x.[trip_cycle_num]=z.[trip_cycle_num] and [close_datetime] is null
						inner join MOVE_TYPE_CODE MT ON MT.move_type_code = x.move_type_code and MT.LAST_STATUS_MOVE = 'Y'	
					where x.[MOVE_DATETIME] = (select max(xx.[move_datetime]) [move_datetime] 																		
													from [eqmt_movement_history] xx	with (nolock) 
														inner join MOVE_TYPE_CODE MTx ON MTx.move_type_code = xx.move_type_code and MTx.LAST_STATUS_MOVE = 'Y'											
													where x.[rtex_road_id]=xx.[rtex_road_id]											
														And x.[eqmt_init]=xx.[eqmt_init] And x.[eqmt_num]=xx.[eqmt_num]										
														And x.[trip_cycle_num]=xx.[trip_cycle_num]
														and (xx.delete_ind is null or xx.delete_ind <> 'Y')	
												group by xx.[rtex_road_id],xx.[eqmt_init],xx.[eqmt_num]										 										
												)	and (x.delete_ind is null or x.delete_ind <> 'Y')																	
					) LST																			
         On S.[rtex_road_id]=LST.[rtex_road_id]																								
            And S.[eqmt_init]=LST.[eqmt_init] And S.[eqmt_num]=LST.[eqmt_num]																								
            And S.[trip_cycle_num]=LST.[trip_cycle_num]	
       Left Join (select INFOMoveTypeCode, MAX(RS4000MoveTypeCode) RS4000MoveTypeCode from [movecode] group by INFOMoveTypeCode) last
		 ON LST.[move_type_code] = last.INFOMoveTypeCode

scripts.text:
UPDATE c
  SET 
      c.ONLINE_PATRON_ID = w.ONLINE_PATRON_ID, 
      c.ONLINE_PATRON_ADDR_TYPE = w.ONLINE_PATRON_ADDR_TYPE, 
      c.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = w.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM, 
      c.UTCLastModifiedOn = GETUTCDATE(), 
      c.MOD_DATETIME = GETDATE()
FROM [dbo].[CHARGE_HISTORY] c
     LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT WAYBILL_NUM, 
           WAYBILL_DATE, 
           WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM, 
           ONLINE_PATRON_ID, 
           ONLINE_PATRON_ADDR_TYPE
    FROM WAYBILL
    UNION
    SELECT WAYBILL_NUM, 
           WAYBILL_DATE, 
           WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM, 
           ONLINE_PATRON_ID, 
           ONLINE_PATRON_ADDR_TYPE
    FROM WAYBILL_HISTORY
) w ON w.WAYBILL_NUM = c.WAYBILL_NUM
       AND CAST(w.WAYBILL_DATE AS DATE) = CAST(c.WAYBILL_DATE AS DATE)
WHERE c.CREATED_BY = 'ISSCONV'
      AND w.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM IS NOT NULL;

  CAST(W.[waybill_cntl_num] AS varchar(9)) [control nbr],
  'R' [trans method cd],
  W.[rtex_road_id] [controlling road],
  RIGHT('000' + CAST(S.STCC AS varchar(10)), 7) [stcc],
  ST.[commodity] [commodity desc],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(R.[ref_num], 1, 25), '') [shipment nbr],
  ISNULL(CAST(W.[orig_fsac] AS varchar(5)), '') [origin fsac],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(O.[state_province_code], 1, 2), '') [origin state],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(O.[station_name], 1, 25), '') [origin station],
  ISNULL(W.[orig_road], '') [origin road],
  ISNULL(CAST(W.[dest_fsac] AS varchar(5)), '') [dest fsac],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(D.[state_province_code], 1, 2), '') [dest state],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(D.[station_name], 1, 25), '') [dest station],
  ISNULL(W.[dest_road], '') [dest road],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(W.[bill_of_lading_num], 1, 25), '') [bill of lading nbr],
  ISNULL(CASE
    WHEN [bill_of_lading_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
    ELSE '1'
  END + CONVERT(char(6), [bill_of_lading_datetime], 12), '') [bill of lading date],
  ISNULL(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(5), W.[bill_of_lading_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS char(4)), '') [bill of lading time],
  ISNULL(R1.[road_id], '') [route road 01],
  ISNULL(R1.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 01],
  ISNULL(R1.[route_seq_num], '') [role 01],
  ISNULL(R2.[road_id], '') [route road 02],
  ISNULL(R2.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 02],
  ISNULL(R2.[route_seq_num], '') [role 02],

  ISNULL(R5.[route_seq_num], '') [role 05],

  ISNULL(R8.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 08],
  ISNULL(R8.[route_seq_num], '') [role 08],
  ISNULL(R9.[road_id], '') [route road 09],
  ISNULL(R9.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 09],
  ISNULL(R9.[route_seq_num], '') [role 09],
  ISNULL(R10.[road_id], '') [route road 10],
  ISNULL(R10.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 10],
  ISNULL(R10.[route_seq_num], '') [role 10],
  ISNULL(R11.[road_id], '') [route road 11],
  ISNULL(R11.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 11],
  ISNULL(R11.[route_seq_num], '') [role 11],
  ISNULL(R12.[road_id], '') [route road 12],
  ISNULL(R12.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 12],

  ISNULL(CN.[patron_ID], '') [consignee ID],

  ISNULL(PF.[patron_ID], '') [freight bill ID],
  ISNULL(PF.[patron_addr_type], '') [freight bill addr],

  ISNULL(W.[online_patron_addr_type], '') [the customer addr],
  '' [the cust parent ID],
  '' [the cust parent addr],
  ISNULL(A.[block_to_id], '') [block to ID],
  ISNULL(A.[block_to_addr], '') [block to addr],
  '' [str entry user id],
  '' [str entry date],
  '' [str entry time],
  SUBSTRING(W.[mod_by], 1, 8) [str user id modified],
  CASE
    WHEN W.[mod_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
    ELSE '1'
  END + CONVERT(char(6), W.[mod_datetime], 12) [str date modified],
  CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(4), W.[mod_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS char(4)) [str time modified],
  GETDATE() [pulledfromRMI]
FROM [waybill_history] W
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  [rtex_road_id],
  [waybill_cntl_num],
  MAX([block_to_id]) [block_to_id],
  MAX([block_to_addr]) [block_to_addr]
FROM [wbhist_watss]
GROUP BY [rtex_road_id],
         [waybill_cntl_num]) A
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = A.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = A.[waybill_cntl_num]
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_stcc] S
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = S.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = S.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND S.[seq_num] = 1
LEFT JOIN [stcc] ST
  ON S.[stcc] = ST.[stcc_code]
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  [rtex_road_id],
  [waybill_cntl_num],
  [ref_num_qual],
  MAX([ref_num]) [ref_num]
FROM [wbhist_ref]
GROUP BY [rtex_road_id],
         [waybill_cntl_num],
         [ref_num_qual]) R
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R.[ref_num_qual] = 'SI'
LEFT JOIN [ref_num_qual_code] Q
  ON Q.[ref_num_qual_code] = R.[ref_num_qual]
  AND Q.[alt_value] = 'BOL'
LEFT JOIN [station] O
  ON W.[orig_road] = O.[road_id]
  AND W.[orig_fsac] = O.[fsac]
  AND W.[orig_fsac] <> 0
LEFT JOIN [station] D
  ON W.[dest_road] = D.[road_id]
  AND W.[dest_fsac] = D.[fsac]
  AND W.[dest_fsac] <> 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) CN
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = CN.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = CN.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND CN.[type_of_party] = 'CN'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) SH
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = SH.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = SH.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND SH.[type_of_party] = 'SH'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) PF
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = PF.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = PF.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND PF.[type_of_party] = 'PF'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) C1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = C1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = C1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND C1.[type_of_party] = 'C1'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WBHIST_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) N1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = N1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = N1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND N1.[type_of_party] = 'N1'
LEFT JOIN [patron] P
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = P.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[online_patron_id] = P.[patron_id]
  AND W.[online_patron_addr_type] = P.[addr_type]
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R1.[seq_num] = '1'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R2
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R2.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R2.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R2.[seq_num] = '2'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R3
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R3.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R3.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R3.[seq_num] = '3'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R4
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R4.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R4.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R4.[seq_num] = '4'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R5
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R5.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R5.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R5.[seq_num] = '5'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R6
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R6.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R6.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R6.[seq_num] = '6'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R7
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R7.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R7.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R7.[seq_num] = '7'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R8
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R8.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R8.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R8.[seq_num] = '8'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R9
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R9.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R9.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R9.[seq_num] = '9'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R10
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R10.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R10.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R10.[seq_num] = '10'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R11
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R11.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R11.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R11.[seq_num] = '11'
LEFT JOIN [wbhist_route] R12
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R12.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R12.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R12.[seq_num] = '12'
WHERE CAST(W.[mod_datetime] AS date) >= CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE()) AS date)
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
  CAST(W.[waybill_cntl_num] AS varchar(9)) [control nbr],
  'R' [trans method cd],
  W.[rtex_road_id] [controlling road],
  RIGHT('000' + CAST(S.STCC AS varchar(10)), 7) [stcc],
  ST.[commodity] [commodity desc],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(R.[ref_num], 1, 25), '') [shipment nbr],
  ISNULL(CAST(W.[orig_fsac] AS varchar(5)), '') [origin fsac],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(O.[state_province_code], 1, 2), '') [origin state],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(O.[station_name], 1, 25), '') [origin station],
  ISNULL(W.[orig_road], '') [origin road],
  ISNULL(CAST(W.[dest_fsac] AS varchar(5)), '') [dest fsac],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(D.[state_province_code], 1, 2), '') [dest state],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(D.[station_name], 1, 25), '') [dest station],
  ISNULL(W.[dest_road], '') [dest road],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(W.[bill_of_lading_num], 1, 25), '') [bill of lading nbr],
  ISNULL(CASE
    WHEN [bill_of_lading_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
    ELSE '1'
  END + CONVERT(char(6), [bill_of_lading_datetime], 12), '') [bill of lading date],
  ISNULL(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(5), W.[bill_of_lading_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS char(4)), '') [bill of lading time],
  ISNULL(R1.[road_id], '') [route road 01],
  ISNULL(R1.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 01],
  ISNULL(R1.[route_seq_num], '') [role 01],
  ISNULL(R2.[road_id], '') [route road 02],
  ISNULL(R2.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 02],
  ISNULL(R2.[route_seq_num], '') [role 02],
  ISNULL(R3.[road_id], '') [route road 03],
  ISNULL(R3.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 03],
  ISNULL(R3.[route_seq_num], '') [role 03],
  ISNULL(R4.[road_id], '') [route road 04],
  ISNULL(R4.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 04],
  ISNULL(R4.[route_seq_num], '') [role 04],
  ISNULL(R5.[road_id], '') [route road 05],
  ISNULL(R5.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 05],
  ISNULL(R5.[route_seq_num], '') [role 05],
  ISNULL(R6.[road_id], '') [route road 06],
  ISNULL(R6.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 06],
  ISNULL(R6.[route_seq_num], '') [role 06],
  ISNULL(R7.[road_id], '') [route road 07],
  ISNULL(R7.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 07],
  ISNULL(R7.[route_seq_num], '') [role 07],
  ISNULL(R8.[road_id], '') [route road 08],
  ISNULL(R8.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 08],
  ISNULL(R8.[route_seq_num], '') [role 08],
  ISNULL(R9.[road_id], '') [route road 09],
  ISNULL(R9.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 09],
  ISNULL(R9.[route_seq_num], '') [role 09],
  ISNULL(R10.[road_id], '') [route road 10],
  ISNULL(R10.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 10],
  ISNULL(R10.[route_seq_num], '') [role 10],
  ISNULL(R11.[road_id], '') [route road 11],
  ISNULL(R11.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 11],
  ISNULL(R11.[route_seq_num], '') [role 11],
  ISNULL(R12.[road_id], '') [route road 12],
  ISNULL(R12.[rule_260_code], '') [station 260 abrev 12],
  ISNULL(R12.[route_seq_num], '') [role 12],
  ISNULL([pymt_method_code], '') [method of payment],
  '' [A/S code],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(CN.[patron_name], 1, 25), '') [consignee name],
  ISNULL(CN.[patron_ID], '') [consignee ID],
  ISNULL(CN.[patron_addr_type], '') [consignee addr],
  '' [consignee parent ID],
  '' [consignee parent addr],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(SH.[patron_name], 1, 25), '') [shipper name],
  ISNULL(SH.[patron_ID], '') [shipper ID],
  ISNULL(SH.[patron_addr_type], '') [shipper addr],
  '' [shipper parent ID],
  '' [shipper parent addr],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(PF.[patron_name], 1, 25), '') [freight bill name],
  ISNULL(PF.[patron_ID], '') [freight bill ID],
  ISNULL(PF.[patron_addr_type], '') [freight bill addr],
  '' [frt bill parent ID],
  '' [frt bill parent addr],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(C1.[patron_name], 1, 25), '') [in care of name],
  ISNULL(C1.[patron_ID], '') [in care of ID],
  ISNULL(C1.[patron_addr_type], '') [in care of addr],
  '' [in care of parent ID],
  '' [in care of parent add],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(N1.[patron_name], 1, 25), '') [notify party name],
  ISNULL(N1.[patron_ID], '') [notify party ID],
  ISNULL(N1.[patron_addr_type], '') [notify party add],
  '' [notify party parent ID],
  '' [notify party parent addr],
  ISNULL(SUBSTRING(P.[name], 1, 25), '') [the customer name],
  ISNULL(W.[online_patron_id], '') [the customer ID],
  ISNULL(W.[online_patron_addr_type], '') [the customer addr],
  '' [the cust parent ID],
  '' [the cust parent addr],
  ISNULL(A.[block_to_id], '') [block to ID],
  ISNULL(A.[block_to_addr], '') [block to addr],
  '' [str entry user id],
  '' [str entry date],
  '' [str entry time],
  SUBSTRING(W.[mod_by], 1, 8) [str user id modified],
  CASE
    WHEN W.[mod_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''

  CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(4), W.[mod_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS int) [str time modified],
  GETDATE() [pulledfromRMI]
FROM [waybill] W
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  [rtex_road_id],
  [waybill_cntl_num],
  MAX([block_to_id]) [block_to_id],
  MAX([block_to_addr]) [block_to_addr]
FROM [wb_watss]
GROUP BY [rtex_road_id],
         [waybill_cntl_num]) A
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = A.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = A.[waybill_cntl_num]
LEFT JOIN [wb_stcc] S
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = S.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = S.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND S.[seq_num] = 1
LEFT JOIN [stcc] ST
  ON S.[stcc] = ST.[stcc_code]
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  [rtex_road_id],
  [waybill_cntl_num],
  [ref_num_qual],
  MAX([ref_num]) [ref_num]
FROM [wb_ref]
GROUP BY [rtex_road_id],
         [waybill_cntl_num],
         [ref_num_qual]) R
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R.[ref_num_qual] = 'SI'
LEFT JOIN [ref_num_qual_code] Q
  ON Q.[ref_num_qual_code] = R.[ref_num_qual]
  AND Q.[alt_value] = 'BOL'
LEFT JOIN [station] O
  ON W.[orig_road] = O.[road_id]
  AND W.[orig_fsac] = O.[fsac]
  AND W.[orig_fsac] <> 0
LEFT JOIN [station] D
  ON W.[dest_road] = D.[road_id]
  AND W.[dest_fsac] = D.[fsac]
  AND W.[dest_fsac] <> 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) CN
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = CN.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = CN.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND CN.[type_of_party] = 'CN'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES SH
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE SH.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND SH.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) SH
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = SH.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = SH.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND SH.[type_of_party] = 'SH'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) PF
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = PF.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = PF.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND PF.[type_of_party] = 'PF'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) C1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = C1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = C1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND C1.[type_of_party] = 'C1'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT
  *
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES CN
WHERE SEQ_NUM = (SELECT
  MIN(SEQ_NUM)
FROM WB_ASSOC_PARTIES
WHERE CN.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.WAYBILL_CNTL_NUM
AND CN.TYPE_OF_PARTY = WB_ASSOC_PARTIES.TYPE_OF_PARTY)) N1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = N1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = N1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND N1.[type_of_party] = 'N1'
LEFT JOIN [patron] P
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = P.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[online_patron_id] = P.[patron_id]
  AND W.[online_patron_addr_type] = P.[addr_type]
LEFT JOIN [wb_route] R1
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R1.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R1.[waybill_cntl_num]
  AND R1.[seq_num] = '1'
LEFT JOIN [wb_route] R2
  ON W.[rtex_road_id] = R2.[rtex_road_id]
  AND W.[waybill_cntl_num] = R2.[waybill_cntl_num]

SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT

   ,ISNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(W.[waybill_num] AS CHAR(11)), 1, 6),

   ,ISNULL
	(CASE
		WHEN W.[waybill_date] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
		ELSE '1'
	END + CONVERT(CHAR(6), W.[waybill_date], 12),
	0) [waybill date]
   ,CASE
		WHEN ISNULL(Fleet_Name, '') = '' THEN SUBSTRING(U.[aar_car_type], 1, 1)
		ELSE SUBSTRING(ISNULL(Fleet_Name, ''), 1, 3)
	END [KD kind key]
   ,CAST(M.[waybill_cntl_num] AS CHAR(9)) [waybill control nbr]
   ,M.[eqmt_init] [equipment initial]
   ,CAST(LEFT(M.eqmt_num, 6) AS CHAR(6)) [equipment number]
   ,CASE
		WHEN M.[move_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
		ELSE '1'
	END + CONVERT(CHAR(6),
	M.[move_datetime],
	12) [EQH event date key]
   ,CAST(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), M.[move_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS INT) AS VARCHAR(4)) [EQH event time key]
   ,CASE M.[move_type_code]
		WHEN 'BLG' THEN 'BADO'
		WHEN 'ICH' THEN 'ICHD'
		WHEN 'HRE' THEN 'OSTH'
		ELSE RS4000MoveTypeCode
	END [EQH move typ key]
   ,'1' [Region ID]
   ,ISNULL(LT.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION],
	'') [station ID]
   ,'1' [to RN ID key]
   ,T.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION] [to SN ID key]
   ,'' [ZN ID key]
   ,ISNULL(M.[location],
	'') [LN ID key]
   ,ISNULL(M.[fromto_road],
	'') [Road]
   ,ISNULL(M.[patron],
	'') [PD ID key]
   ,ISNULL(M.[patron_addr_type],
	'') [patron address type]
   ,ISNULL(CAST(M.[train_id] AS VARCHAR(10)),
	'') [TRH train id key]
   ,'0' [TRH train control nbr key]
   ,'0' [TRH event date key]
   ,'0' [TRH event time key]
   ,'' [TRH move type key]
   ,'' [EQH intermodal status cd]
   ,'0' [EQH car hire extract date]
   ,'0' [EQH car hire extract time]
   ,'R' [EQH trans method cd]
   ,'0' [EQH convey WN control nbr]
   ,ISNULL(M.[conveying_init],
	'') [EQH convey WE equip init]
   ,ISNULL(CAST(M.[conveying_num] AS CHAR(6)),
	'') [EQH convey WE equip nbr K]
   ,'0' [EQH spot date]
   ,'0' [EQH spot time]
   ,CAST(ISNULL(CAST(M.[train_seq_num] AS INT), M.[location_seq_num]) AS CHAR(6)) [EQH train seq]
   ,ISNULL(E.CHASSIS_INIT,
	'') [EQH chassis init]
   ,ISNULL(CAST(E.CHASSIS_NUM AS CHAR(6)),
	'0') [EQH chassis nbr]
   ,'' [EQH intermodal trip ind]
   ,SUBSTRING(M.[mod_by], 1, 8) [STR user ID]
   ,CASE
		WHEN M.[mod_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
		ELSE '1'
	END + CONVERT(CHAR(6),
	M.[mod_datetime],
	12) [STR date entered]
   ,CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(5), M.[mod_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS CHAR(4)) [STR time entered]
   ,ISNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(E.[weight] AS CHAR(20)), 1, 9),
	'0') [weight]
   ,ISNULL(E.[weight_qual],
	'') [WE N704 weight qual]
   ,ISNULL(CAST([tare_wt] AS CHAR(9)),
	'0') [tare weight]
   ,'0' [weight allowance]
   ,'' [tare qual]
   ,'' [equipmenthistoryID]

FROM [eqmt_movement_history] M WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN [waybill] W WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON M.[rtex_road_id] = W.[rtex_road_id]
		AND M.[waybill_cntl_num] = W.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND ISNULL(M.delete_ind, '') = ''

		AND E.[eqmt_init] = M.[eqmt_init]
		AND E.[eqmt_num] = M.[eqmt_num]

	ON WW.[rtex_road_id] = M.[rtex_road_id]
		AND WW.[waybill_cntl_num] = M.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND WW.[eqmt_init] = M.[eqmt_init]
		AND WW.[eqmt_num] = M.[eqmt_num]
INNER JOIN [umler] U
	ON M.[eqmt_init] = U.[eqmt_init]
		AND M.[eqmt_num] = U.[eqmt_num]
INNER JOIN (SELECT
		INFOMoveTypeCode

WHERE (M.DELETE_IND IS NULL
OR M.DELETE_IND <> 'Y')
AND CAST(M.[mod_datetime] AS DATE) >= CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -10, GETDATE()) AS DATE)
AND (MH.MOVE_DATETIME IS NULL

		MAX(Move_datetime) lastMoveDT
	FROM EQMT_MOVEMENT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE M.[rtex_road_id] = [rtex_road_id]
	AND M.[waybill_cntl_num] = [waybill_cntl_num]

	AND M.[eqmt_num] = [eqmt_num]

   ,ISNULL(E.CHASSIS_INIT, '') [EQH chassis init]
   ,ISNULL(CAST(E.CHASSIS_NUM AS CHAR(6)), '0') [EQH chassis nbr]
   ,'' [EQH intermodal trip ind]
   ,SUBSTRING(M.[mod_by], 1, 8) [STR user ID]
   ,CASE
		WHEN M.[mod_datetime] < '1/1/2000' THEN ''
		ELSE '1'
	END + CONVERT(CHAR(6), M.[mod_datetime], 12) [STR date entered]
   ,CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(5), M.[mod_datetime], 8), ':', '') AS CHAR(4)) [STR time entered]
   ,ISNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(E.[weight] AS CHAR(20)), 1, 9), '0') [weight]
   ,ISNULL(E.[weight_qual], '') [WE N704 weight qual]
   ,ISNULL(CAST([tare_wt] AS CHAR(9)), '0') [tare weight]
   ,'0' [weight allowance]
   ,'' [tare qual]
   ,'' [equipmenthistoryID]


FROM [eqmt_movement_history] M WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN [waybill_history] W WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON M.[rtex_road_id] = W.[rtex_road_id]
		AND M.[waybill_cntl_num] = W.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND ISNULL(M.delete_ind, '') = ''
INNER JOIN [wbhist_eqmt] E WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON E.[rtex_road_id] = M.[rtex_road_id]
		AND E.[waybill_cntl_num] = M.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND E.[eqmt_init] = M.[eqmt_init]
		AND E.[eqmt_num] = M.[eqmt_num]
INNER JOIN [wbhist_watss] WW WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WW.[rtex_road_id] = M.[rtex_road_id]
		AND WW.[waybill_cntl_num] = M.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND WW.[eqmt_init] = M.[eqmt_init]
		AND WW.[eqmt_num] = M.[eqmt_num]
INNER JOIN [umler] U
	ON M.[eqmt_init] = U.[eqmt_init]
		AND M.[eqmt_num] = U.[eqmt_num]
INNER JOIN (SELECT
		INFOMoveTypeCode
	   ,MAX(RS4000MoveTypeCode) RS4000MoveTypeCode
	FROM [movecode]
	GROUP BY INFOMoveTypeCode) [movecode]
	ON M.[move_type_code] = INFOMoveTypeCode
LEFT JOIN [station] T
	ON M.[rtex_road_id] = T.[road_id]
		AND M.[fsac] = T.[fsac]
LEFT JOIN [eqmt_movement_history] MH WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON M.[rtex_road_id] = MH.[rtex_road_id]
		AND M.[waybill_cntl_num] = MH.[waybill_cntl_num]
		AND M.[eqmt_init] = MH.[eqmt_init]
		AND M.[eqmt_num] = MH.[eqmt_num]
		AND M.MOVE_DATETIME > MH.move_datetime
		AND M.[move_type_code] <> 'ICR'
LEFT JOIN [station] LT
	ON MH.[rtex_road_id] = LT.[road_id]
		AND MH.[fsac] = LT.[fsac]
WHERE (M.DELETE_IND IS NULL
OR M.DELETE_IND <> 'Y')
AND CAST(M.[mod_datetime] AS DATE) >= CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -10, GETDATE()) AS DATE)
AND (MH.MOVE_DATETIME IS NULL
OR MH.MOVE_DATETIME = (SELECT
		MAX(Move_datetime) lastMoveDT
	FROM EQMT_MOVEMENT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE M.[rtex_road_id] = [rtex_road_id]
	AND M.[waybill_cntl_num] = [waybill_cntl_num]
	AND M.[eqmt_init] = [eqmt_init]
	AND M.[eqmt_num] = [eqmt_num]
	AND MOVE_DATETIME < M.MOVE_DATETIME
	AND (DELETE_IND IS NULL
	OR DELETE_IND <> 'Y'))
)
ORDER BY [railroad],
[equipment initial],
[equipment number],
[EQH event date key],
[EQH event time key]

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #updt_ACCRUAL_STATUS_MANAGER;
WITH accrl_br_status_processed_CTE AS  
(SELECT 
        DOCUMENT_NUMBER,
        COMPANY_CODE, 
        FISCAL_YEAR,
        1 AS PROCESSED_IND
    FROM @{pipeline().parameters.stg_dbSchema}.@{pipeline().parameters.tbl_STG_ACCRUAL_BR_STATUS}
)
SELECT 
    br_stat.*, 
    '@{variables('Load_Datetime')}' AS ETL_UPDATE_DATETM
INTO #updt_ACCRUAL_STATUS_MANAGER
FROM accrl_br_status_processed_CTE br_stat
JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.stg_dbSchema}.@{pipeline().parameters.tbl_Accrual_Status_Master} stat_mstr ON 
    br_stat.DOCUMENT_NUMBER = stat_mstr.DOCUMENT_NUMBER AND
    br_stat.COMPANY_CODE = stat_mstr.COMPANY_CODE AND
    br_stat.FISCAL_YEAR = stat_mstr.FISCAL_YEAR
WHERE 
    br_stat.Processed_Ind <> stat_mstr.Processed_Ind

UPDATE trg
SET 
    trg.Processed_Ind = src.Processed_Ind, 
    trg.ETL_UPDATE_DATETM = src.ETL_UPDATE_DATETM
FROM 
    @{pipeline().parameters.stg_dbSchema}.@{pipeline().parameters.tbl_Accrual_Status_Master} trg
INNER JOIN #updt_ACCRUAL_STATUS_MANAGER src ON 
    trg.DOCUMENT_NUMBER = src.DOCUMENT_NUMBER AND
    trg.COMPANY_CODE = src.COMPANY_CODE AND
    trg.FISCAL_YEAR = src.FISCAL_YEAR

SELECT 
     SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,'HDR', TRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(8), stg.Posting_Date, 12)) + PROFIT_CENTER),1,18) as ZUONR
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0, NULL, CAST(CAST(stg.GL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER as int) as nvarchar(10))),1,10) as NEWKO
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,NULL, 
        CASE
            WHEN cast(stg.GL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER as int) >= 100000 AND cast(stg.GL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER as int) <= 499999
            THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(CAST(stg.COST_CENTER as int) as nvarchar(20))
        END),1,10) as KOSTL
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,NULL,CAST(stg.AMOUNT as nvarchar(30))),1,12) as WRBTR
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,NULL,CAST(stg.ITEM_TEXT as nvarchar(50))),1,50) as SGTX
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,NULL,stg.Company_Code),1,4) as BUKRS
    ,IIF(stg.WBS_ELEMENT=0,NULL,stg.WBS_ELEMENT) as PROJK
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,NULL,CAST(CAST(stg.PROFIT_CENTER as int) as nvarchar(20))),1,10) as PRCTR
    ,Posting_Date as PBLDAT
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,CONVERT(nvarchar(8), stg.Posting_Date, 12),NULL),1,16) as PXBLNR
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,CONVERT(nvarchar(8), stg.Posting_Date, 12),NULL),1,25) as PBKTXT
    ,SUBSTRING(IIF(stg.LINE_NUMBER=0,stg.Company_Code,NULL),1,4) as PAPBUKRS

@concat('  
SELECT R.TYPE
, R.ID
, R.NUMBER
, R.MESSAGE
, R.LOG_NO
, R.LOG_MSG_NO
, R.MESSAGE_V1
, R.MESSAGE_V2
, R.MESSAGE_V3
, R.MESSAGE_V4
, R.AL_RFC_RETCODE
, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(R.MESSAGE, ''Document posted successfully: '', ''''), 1, 10) DOCUMENT_NUMBER
, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(R.MESSAGE, ''Document posted successfully: '', ''''), CHARINDEX('' '', REPLACE(R.MESSAGE, ''Document posted successfully: '', ''''), 0) + 1, 4) COMPANY_CODE
, RIGHT(R.MESSAGE, COALESCE(NULLIF(CHARINDEX('' '', REVERSE(R.MESSAGE)), 0) - 1, 0)) FISCAL_YEAR
, BR.ZUONR BR_ID
FROM OPENJSON((SELECT ReturnValue
FROM [LABRACCRL].[STG_ACCRUAL_BR_RETURN]))
WITH(TYPE VARCHAR(1) ''$.TYPE'',
ID VARCHAR(20) ''$.ID'',
NUMBER DECIMAL(3,0) ''$.NUMBER'',
MESSAGE VARCHAR(220) ''$.MESSAGE'',
LOG_NO VARCHAR(20) ''$.LOG_NO'',
LOG_MSG_NO DECIMAL(6,0) ''$.LOG_MSG_NO'',
MESSAGE_V1 VARCHAR(2) ''$.MESSAGE_V1'',
MESSAGE_V2 VARCHAR(2) ''$.MESSAGE_V2'',
MESSAGE_V3 VARCHAR(2) ''$.MESSAGE_V3'',
MESSAGE_V4 VARCHAR(2) ''$.MESSAGE_V4'',
AL_RFC_RETCODE VARCHAR(256) ''$.AL_RFC_RETCODE'') R
CROSS APPLY (SELECT MAX(CONVERT(CHAR(8),POSTING_DATE,112)) + COALESCE(PROFIT_CENTER,'''') ZUONR

SELECT

      ,[MaterialItemCode] AS EstMaterial

      ,ISNULL([WorkCenter],'') AS Workcenter

MERGE [dbo].[PriceAuthorityShipmentCondition] AS tgt
USING etl.PriceAuthorityShipmentConditionStg AS src
	ON (
				tgt.[PriceAuthorityGuid] = src.[PriceAuthorityGuid]
			AND isnull(tgt.[ContractLevel], '') = isnull(src.[ContractLevel], '')
			AND isnull(tgt.[RateGroupId], 0) = isnull(src.[RateGroupId], 0)
			AND isnull(tgt.[SubGroupCode], 0) = isnull(src.[SubGroupCode], 0)
