INSERT INTO [etl].[PriceAuthorityShipmentConditionStg]
        ([PriceAuthorityGuid], 
         [ContractLevel], 
         [RateGroupId], 
         [SubGroupCode], 
         [ConditionCode], 
         [ConditionValue], 
         [ConditionFromValue], 
         [ConditionToValue], 
         [RateColNbr], 
         [LogicalConnector], 
         [IsExcludedFlag], 
         [ShipmentConditionTypeCode], 
         [GeoLocationLevel], 
         [GeoLocationId], 
         [EffectiveDate], 
         [ExpirationDate]
        )
               SELECT [PriceAuthorityGuid], 
                      [ContractLevel], 
                      [RateGroupId], 
                      [SubGroupCode], 
                      [ConditionCode], 
                      [ConditionValue], 
                      [ConditionFromValue], 
                      CASE WHEN [ConditionCode] = 'SURC' THEN CAST(CAST([ConditionToValue] as money) / cast(100.00 as money) as varchar(15)) ELSE [ConditionToValue] END AS [ConditionToValue], 
                      [RateColNbr], 
                      [LogicalConnector], 
                      [IsExcludedFlag], 
                      [ShipmentConditionTypeCode], 
                      [GeoLocationLevel], 
                      [GeoLocationId], 
                      [EffectiveDate], 
                      [ExpirationDate]
               FROM [etl].[ShipmentConditionStg]
               WHERE [ContractLevel] = 'H';

        INSERT INTO [etl].[FreightRateShipmentConditionStg]
        ([RateId], 
         [ContractLevel], 
         [RateGroupId], 
         [SubGroupCode], 
         [ConditionCode], 
         [ConditionValue], 
         [ConditionFromValue], 
         [ConditionToValue], 
         [RateColNbr], 
         [LogicalConnector], 
         [IsExcludedFlag], 
         [ShipmentConditionTypeCode], 
         [GeoLocationLevel], 
         [GeoLocationId], 
         [EffectiveDate], 
         [ExpirationDate]
        )
               SELECT fr.[RateId], 
                      s.[ContractLevel], 
                      s.[RateGroupId], 
                      s.[SubGroupCode], 
                      s.[ConditionCode], 
                      s.[ConditionValue], 
                      s.[ConditionFromValue], 
                      CASE WHEN s.[ConditionCode] = 'SURC' THEN CAST(CAST(s.[ConditionToValue] as money) / cast(100.00 as money) as varchar(15)) ELSE s.[ConditionToValue] END AS [ConditionToValue], 
                      s.[RateColNbr], 
                      s.[LogicalConnector], 
                      s.[IsExcludedFlag], 
                      s.[ShipmentConditionTypeCode], 
                      s.[GeoLocationLevel], 
                      s.[GeoLocationId], 
                      s.[EffectiveDate], 
                      s.[ExpirationDate]
               FROM [etl].[ShipmentConditionStg] s
                    JOIN [dbo].[FreightRate] fr ON fr.[SecondaryLocationId] = s.[SecondaryLocationId]
                                    AND coalesce(fr.RateColNbr, 0) = case s.RateColNbr
									when 0 then coalesce(fr.RateColNbr, 0)
									when null then coalesce(fr.RateColNbr, 0)
									else s.RateColNbr end
               WHERE [ContractLevel] = 'S';

DECLARE @GV_Load_Datetime DATETIME = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Central Standard Time'' AS datetime);
DECLARE @XML xml = N''', xml(replace(replace(string(xml(activity('GetEmployeeHistory').output.Response)), '''', ''''''),'"UTF-8"','"UTF-16"')),'''
TRUNCATE TABLE ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.Employment_History;
INSERT INTO ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.Employment_History
            (Person_Id
           ,PERSON_ID_EXTERNAL
           ,BUSINESS_AREA
           ,COMPANY
           ,COST_CENTER
           ,COST_CENTER_EXTERNALCODE
           ,COST_CENTER_INT
           ,CREATED_ON_DATETM
           ,DATE_START
           ,DATE_END
           ,DATE_ORIGINAL_START
           ,DATE_REHIRE
           ,DATE_SERVICE
           ,EMPLOYEE_STATUS
           ,EVENT_REASON_CODE
           ,EVENT_REASON_DESC
           ,EVENT_REASON_ID
           ,EVENT_REASON_NAME
           ,Job_Code
           ,Personnel_Area
           ,Personnel_SubArea
           ,SAPECC_Term_Code
           ,ETL_Source_Id
           ,ETL_Insert_Datetm
           ,ETL_Update_Datetm)
SELECT	ce.p.value(''(*:person_id/text())[1]'',''varchar(42)'') AS person_id,
	ce.p.value(''(*:person_id_external/text())[1]'',''varchar(32)'') AS PERSON_ID_EXTERNAL,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:custom_string5/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS BUSINESS_AREA,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:company/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS COMPANY,
	LTRIM(SUBSTRING(ei.ji.value(''(*:cost_center/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)''), 5, 100), ''0'') AS COST_CENTER,
    SUBSTRING(ei.ji.value(''(*:cost_center/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)''), 1, 100) COST_CENTER_EXTERNALCODE,
    CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(ei.ji.value(''(*:cost_center/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)''), 5, 100)) = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(ei.ji.value(''(*:cost_center/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)''), 5, 100) < 9999999999
        THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(ei.ji.value(''(*:cost_center/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)''), 5, 100) AS INT)
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END COST_CENTER_INT,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:created_on_timestamp/text())[1]'',''datetime'') AS CREATED_ON_DATETM,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:start_date/text())[1]'',''date'') AS DATE_START,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:end_date/text())[1]'',''date'') AS DATE_END,
	pe.ei.value(''(*:end_date/text())[1]'',''date'') AS DATE_ORIGINAL_START,
	pe.ei.value(''(*:custom_date3/text())[1]'',''date'') AS DATE_REHIRE,
	pe.ei.value(''(*:serviceDate/text())[1]'',''date'') AS DATE_SERVICE,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:emplStatus/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS EMPLOYEE_STATUS,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:event_reason/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS EVENT_REASON_CODE,
	er.description AS EVENT_REASON_DESC,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:event/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS EVENT_REASON_ID,
	er.name AS EVENT_REASON_NAME,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:job_code/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS Job_Code,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:custom_string15/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS Personnel_Area,
	ei.ji.value(''(*:custom_string16/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') AS Personnel_SubArea,
	tr.SAPECC_TERM_CODE AS SAPECC_Term_Code,
    ''33'' AS ETL_Source_Id,
    @GV_Load_Datetime AS ETL_Insert_Datetm,
    @GV_Load_Datetime AS ETL_Update_Datetm

FROM (VALUES(@XML))V(X)
    CROSS APPLY V.X.nodes(''/*:Envelope/*:Body/*:queryResponse/*:result/*:sfobject/*:person'') ce(p)
	CROSS APPLY ce.p.nodes(''*:employment_information'') pe(ei)
    CROSS APPLY pe.ei.nodes(''*:job_information'') ei(ji)
	LEFT JOIN ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.Stg_FO_EventReason er ON ei.ji.value(''(*:event_reason/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') = er.externalCode	
	LEFT JOIN ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.Dim_SAPECC_TermReason_Xref tr ON ei.ji.value(''(*:event_reason/text())[1]'',''varchar(256)'') = tr.Event_Reason')

SELECT TRIM([equipment initial]) as EquipmentInitial, 
       [equipment number] as EquipmentNumber, 
       [pool code] as Pool, 
       ISNULL([weight], 0) + ISNULL([tare weight], 0) AS GrossWeight, 
       ISNULL([weight], 0) AS NetWeight, 
       ISNULL([tare weight], 0) AS TareWeight, 
       TRIM(lessee) as Lessee, 
       TRIM([station ID]) as Station, 
       TRIM([track id]) as Track, 
	   [track/train position] as SeqNum,
       TRIM([l/e status]) as Le, 
       TRIM([last move type]) as LastMove, 
       LastMoveDateTime as LastMoveDateTime, 
       [equipment kind] AS CarKind,
	   --RcvdDateTime,
	   --[BOL number] as BolNumber,
	   --[BILL_OF_LADING_DATETIME] as BolDateTime,
	   --[commodity description] as Commodity,
	   --[STS - track] as ReqTrack,
	   --[STS - spot] as ReqSpot,
	   --trim([shipper name]) as Shipper,
	   --trim([origin city]) + ', ' + trim([origin state]) as Origin,
       GETDATE() as SnapshotDateTime from (
Select distinct																								
	   S.[rtex_road_id]                              [client road]																							
       ,cast(S.[waybill_cntl_num] as decimal(18,0))  [control number]																								
       ,S.[eqmt_init]                                [equipment initial]																								
       ,cast(S.[eqmt_num] as decimal(18,0))          [equipment number]																								
       ,isnull(cast(W.[waybill_num] as decimal(18,0)),0) [waybill number]																								
       ,isnull(CONVERT(CHAR(8), W.[waybill_date], 112),0) [waybill date]																								
       ,S.[eqmt_status_code]                         [l/e status]																								
       ,U.[aar_car_type]                             [aar car type]																								
       ,case when isnull(Fleet_Name,'') = '' then substring(U.[aar_car_type],1,1) else substring(isnull(Fleet_Name,''),1,3) end                      [equipment kind]																								
       ,isnull(right('0000' + cast([stcc] as varchar(10)),7),'0')      [stcc]																								
       ,isnull(substring(ST.[commodity],1,25),'')	 [commodity description]																			
       ,T.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION]				 [station ID]																			
       ,''  										 [zone ID]														
       ,S.[location]								 [track id]																
       ,isnull(substring(L.Name,1,25),'')			 [location comment]														
       ,isnull(cast(S.[train_id] as varchar(25)),'') [train id]																								
       ,isnull(cast(S.[train_seq_num] as int),S.[location_seq_num]) [track/train position]																								
       ,isnull(A.[Block_to_id],'')					 [block to ID key]																		
       ,isnull(A.[Block_to_addr],'')				 [block to address type]																				
       ,isnull(cast(E.[weight] as decimal(18,0)),0)	 [weight]																							
       ,E.[weight_qual]								 [weight type]																
       ,isnull(cast([tare_wt] as decimal(18,0)),0)   [tare weight]																								
       ,isnull(U.[outside_lth],0)                    [length]																								
       ,case when isnull(S.[BAD_ORDER_REASON_CODE],'') = '' then '' else 'Y' end [bad order indicator]																								
       ,isnull(substring(O.[station_name],1,25),'')	 [origin city]																			
       ,isnull(O.[state_province_code],'')			 [origin state]																					
       ,isnull(substring(D.[station_name],1,25),'')	 [destination city]																			
       ,isnull(D.[state_province_code],'')			 [destination state]																					
       ,isnull(substring(SH.[patron_name],1,25),'')	 [shipper name]																			
       ,isnull(substring(CN.[patron_name],1,25),'')	 [consignee name]																			
       ,case when isnull(R.[RWC_TYPE],'') = '1' then 'T' else 'P' end [inbound/outbound indicator]																								
       ,case when S.[rtex_road_id] <> A.[WATSS_FROM_ROAD]	then A.[WATSS_FROM_ROAD] else case when S.[rtex_road_id] <> A.[WATSS_TO_ROAD] then A.[WATSS_TO_ROAD] else '' end end [connecting road]

            And M.[eqmt_init]=MH.[eqmt_init]														
            And M.[eqmt_num]=MH.[eqmt_num]
            And M.MOVE_DATETIME > MH.move_datetime
            And M.[move_type_code] <> 'ICR' 
       Left Join [station] LT														
         On MH.[rtex_road_id]=LT.[road_id]														
			And MH.[fsac]=LT.[fsac]
  where(M.DELETE_IND IS NULL or M.DELETE_IND <> 'Y') 
        
 UNION
 
 Select M.[rtex_road_id]                             [railroad]													
       ,M.[eqmt_status_code]                         [WE equip status cd]														
       ,isnull(substring(cast(W.[waybill_num] as char(11)),1,6),0) [waybill nbr]														
       ,isnull(Case When W.[waybill_date]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(6), W.[waybill_date], 12),0) [waybill date]														
       ,case when isnull(Fleet_Name,'') = '' then substring(U.[aar_car_type],1,1) else substring(isnull(Fleet_Name,''),1,3) end [KD kind key]														
       ,cast(M.[waybill_cntl_num] as char(9))		 [waybill nbr]													
       ,M.[eqmt_init]                                [equipment initial]														
       ,cast(M.[eqmt_num] as decimal(18,0))          [equipment number]														
       ,Case When M.[move_datetime]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(6), M.[move_datetime], 12) [EQH event date key]														
       ,cast(cast(replace(convert(varchar(5), M.[move_datetime], 8),':','') as int) as VARCHAR(4)) [EQH event time key]														
       ,CASE M.[move_type_code] WHEN 'BLG' THEN 'BADO' WHEN 'ICH' THEN 'ICHD' WHEN 'HRE' THEN 'OSTH' ELSE RS4000MoveTypeCode END [EQH move typ key]							
       ,'1'											 [Region ID]			
       ,isnull(LT.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION],'')				 [station ID]				
       ,'1'											 [to RN ID key]			
       ,T.[WATSS_STATION_ABBREVIATION]				 [to SN ID key]									
       ,''  										 [ZN ID key]				
       ,isnull(M.[location],'')						 [LN ID key]						
       ,isnull(M.[fromto_road],'')  				 [Road]						
       ,isnull(M.[patron],'')						 [PD ID key]					
       ,isnull(M.[patron_addr_type],'')				 [patron address type]							
       ,isnull(cast(M.[train_id] as varchar(10)),'') [TRH train id key]														
       ,'0'											 [TRH train control nbr key]			
       ,'0'											 [TRH event date key]			
       ,'0'											 [TRH event time key]			
       ,''											 [TRH move type key]			
       ,''											 [EQH intermodal status cd]			
       ,'0'											 [EQH car hire extract date]			
       ,'0'											 [EQH car hire extract time]			
       ,'R'											 [EQH trans method cd]			
       ,'0'											 [EQH convey WN control nbr]			
       ,isnull(M.[conveying_init],'')				 [EQH convey WE equip init]									
       ,isnull(cast(M.[conveying_num] as char(6)),'')[EQH convey WE equip nbr K]									
       ,'0'											 [EQH spot date]			
       ,'0'											 [EQH spot time]			
       ,isnull(M.[train_seq_num],M.[location_seq_num]) [EQH train seq]														
       ,isnull(E.CHASSIS_INIT,'')					 [EQH chassis init]			
       ,isnull(cast(E.CHASSIS_NUM as char(6)),'0')	 [EQH chassis nbr]			
       ,''											 [EQH intermodal trip ind]			
       ,substring(M.[mod_by],1,8)					 [STR user ID]					
       ,Case When M.[mod_datetime]<'1/1/2000' Then '' Else '1' End+CONVERT(CHAR(6), M.[mod_datetime], 12) [STR date entered]														
       ,cast(replace(convert(char(5), M.[mod_datetime], 8),':','') as char(4)) [STR time entered]														
       ,isnull(substring(cast(E.[weight] as char(20)),1,9),'0')	 [weight]													
       ,isnull(E.[weight_qual],'')					 [WE N704 weight qual]						
       ,isnull(cast([tare_wt] as char(9)),'0')		 [tare weight]														
       ,'0'											 [weight allowance]			
       ,''											 [tare qual]			
       ,''											 [equipmenthistoryID]				
        														
  From  [eqmt_status] S with (nolock) 
		Inner Join	
		[eqmt_movement_history] M	with (nolock)
		on S.[waybill_cntl_num]=M.[waybill_cntl_num]														
            And S.[eqmt_init]=M.[eqmt_init]														
            And S.[eqmt_num]=M.[eqmt_num]	Inner Join [waybill_history] W	with (nolock)														
         On M.[rtex_road_id]=W.[rtex_road_id]														
            And M.[waybill_cntl_num]=W.[waybill_cntl_num]
            and isnull(M.delete_ind,'') = '' 														
       Inner Join [wbhist_eqmt] E		with (nolock)													
         On E.[rtex_road_id]=M.[rtex_road_id]														
            And E.[waybill_cntl_num]=M.[waybill_cntl_num]														
            And E.[eqmt_init]=M.[eqmt_init]														
            And E.[eqmt_num]=M.[eqmt_num]														
       Inner Join [wbhist_watss] WW		with (nolock)													
         On WW.[rtex_road_id]=M.[rtex_road_id]														
            And WW.[waybill_cntl_num]=M.[waybill_cntl_num]														
            And WW.[eqmt_init]=M.[eqmt_init]														
            And WW.[eqmt_num]=M.[eqmt_num]																												
	   Inner Join [umler] U														
         On M.[eqmt_init]=U.[eqmt_init]														
            And M.[eqmt_num]=U.[eqmt_num]														
              Inner Join (select INFOMoveTypeCode, MAX(RS4000MoveTypeCode) RS4000MoveTypeCode from [movecode] group by INFOMoveTypeCode) [movecode]
		 ON M.[move_type_code] = INFOMoveTypeCode															
	   Left Join [station] T														
         On M.[rtex_road_id]=T.[road_id]														
			And M.[fsac]=T.[fsac]
	   Left Join [eqmt_movement_history] MH with (nolock)
		 On M.[rtex_road_id]=MH.[rtex_road_id]														
            And M.[waybill_cntl_num]=MH.[waybill_cntl_num]
            And M.[eqmt_init]=MH.[eqmt_init]														
            And M.[eqmt_num]=MH.[eqmt_num]
            And M.MOVE_DATETIME > MH.move_datetime
            And M.[move_type_code] <> 'ICR' 
        Left Join [station] LT														
         On MH.[rtex_road_id]=LT.[road_id]														
			And MH.[fsac]=LT.[fsac]
   where (M.DELETE_IND IS NULL or M.DELETE_IND <> 'Y') 
ORDER BY [railroad],[equipment initial],[equipment number],[EQH event date key],[EQH event time key]

      , SUM(CAST([LaborSalesTax] AS FLOAT)) Sales_Tax_Labor
      , SUM(CAST([MaterialSalesTax] AS FLOAT)) Sales_Tax_Material

GROUP BY

      ,[InvoiceNumber]

	  ,[CurrencyIndicator]
      ,[BTP]
      ,[Active]
      ,[AccountDate]
      ,[ConversionFactor]
      ,[Version]

,l.NAME name

,l.ADDRESSNAVDEFLT_COUNTRY address_country
,LEFT(l.ADDRESSNAVDEFLT_COUNTRY, 2) address_country_iso2

	THEN 'United States'
	WHEN l.ADDRESSNAVDEFLT_COUNTRY = 'CAN'

	ELSE l.ADDRESSNAVDEFLT_COUNTRY
 END address_countryName

DECLARE @XML xml = N''', xml(replace(replace(string(xml(activity('GetPhone_More').output.Response)), '''', ''''''),'"UTF-8"','"UTF-16"')),'''
SELECT	ce.p.value(''(*:person_id/text())[1]'',''varchar(42)'') AS person_id,
		ph.phi.value(''(*:extension/text())[1]'',''varchar(32)'') extension,
		ph.phi.value(''(*:phone_number/text())[1]'',''varchar(32)'') phone_number,
		ph.phi.value(''(*:phone_type/text())[1]'',''varchar(32)'') phone_type
INTO #SF_phone_temp1
FROM (VALUES(@XML))V(X)
	 CROSS APPLY V.X.nodes(''/*:Envelope/*:Body/*:queryMoreResponse/*:result/*:sfobject/*:person'') ce(p)
	 CROSS APPLY ce.p.nodes(''*:phone_information'') ph(phi) 

INSERT INTO ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.[Stg_SF_Phone] 
		   ([person_id]
		   ,[mobile_extension]
		   ,[mobile_phone_number]
		   ,[business_extension]
		   ,[business_phone_number])
SELECT  COALESCE(c.person_id, b.person_id) person_id
	, c.extension mobile_extension
	, c.phone_number mobile_phone_number
	, b.extension business_extension
	, b.phone_number business_phone_number
	FROM
	(
	SELECT	person_id,
			extension,
			phone_number,
			phone_type
	FROM #SF_phone_temp1
	WHERE phone_number IS NOT NULL
		AND phone_type = ''C'' 
	) c
	FULL OUTER JOIN
	(
	SELECT	person_id,
			extension,
			phone_number,
			phone_type
	FROM #SF_phone_temp1
	WHERE phone_number IS NOT NULL
		AND phone_type = ''B'' 
	) b ON c.person_id = b.person_id')

INSERT INTO ',pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema,'.[Stg_SF_Phone] 
		   ([person_id]
		   ,[mobile_extension]
		   ,[mobile_phone_number]
		   ,[business_extension]
		   ,[business_phone_number])
SELECT  COALESCE(c.person_id, b.person_id) person_id
	, c.extension mobile_extension
	, c.phone_number mobile_phone_number
	, b.extension business_extension
	, b.phone_number business_phone_number
	FROM
	(
	SELECT	person_id,
			extension,
			phone_number,
			phone_type
	FROM #SF_phone_temp1
	WHERE phone_number IS NOT NULL
		AND phone_type = ''C'' 
	) c
	FULL OUTER JOIN
	(
	SELECT	person_id,
			extension,
			phone_number,
			phone_type
	FROM #SF_phone_temp1
	WHERE phone_number IS NOT NULL
		AND phone_type = ''B'' 
	) b ON c.person_id = b.person_id')

UPDATE e	
	SET e.PHONE_NUMBER_BUSINESS = RTRIM(p.business_phone_number + ' ' + COALESCE(p.business_extension, ''))
	, e.PHONE_NUMBER_MOBILE = RTRIM(p.mobile_phone_number + ' ' + COALESCE(p.mobile_extension, ''))
	, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS = em.email_address
	, e.COMPANY_NAME = c.name
	, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dp.name 
	, e.DIVISION_NAME = dv.name 
	, e.LOCATION_NAME = l.name
	, e.LOCATION_ADDRESS1 =	l.address_address1
	, e.LOCATION_ADDRESS2 = l.address_address2 
	, e.LOCATION_CITY = l.address_city
	, e.LOCATION_STATE =l.address_state_code
	, e.LOCATION_ZIP = l.address_zip_code
	, e.LOCATION_COUNTRY = l.address_country 
FROM @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.STG_SF_COMBINE_WITH_MANAGER e 
LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Phone p ON e.PERSON_ID = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Email em ON e.PERSON_ID = em.person_id
LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Department dp ON e.DEPARTMENT = dp.externalCode

LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Division dv ON e.DIVISION_CODE = dv.externalCode
LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Company c ON e.COMPANY = c.externalCode

WITH OpenWscs
AS (
	SELECT [KUNNR]
		,SUM(CASE [SHKZG]
				WHEN 'H'
					THEN - 1.0 * CAST([DMBTR] AS DECIMAL(13,2))
				ELSE CAST([DMBTR] AS DECIMAL(13,2))
				END) AS [DMBTR]
	FROM [sap].[BSID]
	WHERE (
			BUKRS = 'WSCS'
			OR BUKRS = 'ATLL'
			)
		AND isnumeric(KUNNR) = 1
	GROUP BY [KUNNR]
	)
	,OpenAll
AS (
	SELECT [KUNNR]
		,SUM(CASE [SHKZG]
				WHEN 'H'
					THEN - 1.0 * CAST([DMBTR] AS DECIMAL(13,2))
				ELSE CAST([DMBTR] AS DECIMAL(13,2))
				END) AS [DMBTR]
	FROM [sap].[BSID]
	WHERE isnumeric(KUNNR) = 1
	GROUP BY [KUNNR]
	)
	,Customer
AS (
	SELECT [KUNNR]
	FROM [sap].[KNB1]
	WHERE (
			BUKRS = 'WSCS'
			OR BUKRS = 'ATLL'
			)
		AND isnumeric(KUNNR) = 1
	)
SELECT '"' + bp.CUSTOMER + '"' AS Customer
	,CAST(ISNULL(cl.CREDIT_LIMIT, 0.0) AS DECIMAL(13,2)) AS [Credit Limit]
	,CAST(ISNULL(ow.DMBTR, 0.0) AS DECIMAL(13,2)) AS [WSCS Open AR]
	,CAST(ISNULL(oa.DMBTR, 0.0) AS DECIMAL(13,2)) AS [Total Open AR]
FROM Customer c
LEFT JOIN [sap].[IBUPACUSTOMER] bp ON bp.[CUSTOMER] = c.[KUNNR]
LEFT JOIN [sap].[UKMBP_CMS_SGM] cl ON cl.[CREDIT_SGMNT] = 'ZWAC' and cl.[PARTNER] = bp.[BUSINESSPARTNER]
LEFT JOIN OpenWscs ow ON ow.KUNNR = c.KUNNR
LEFT JOIN OpenAll oa ON oa.KUNNR = c.KUNNR
ORDER BY bp.CUSTOMER

DECLARE @GV_Load_Datetime DATETIME2(7) = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS datetime);


	WITH Loc AS 
	(
	SELECT externalCode Location_Code
      ,date_start Date_Active_Start
      ,date_end Date_Active_End
      ,name Location_Name
      ,description Location_Description
      ,address_address1 Location_Address1
      ,address_address2 Location_Address2
      ,address_city Location_City
      ,address_county Location_County
      ,address_state_code Location_State_Code
      ,address_state_name Location_State_Name
      ,address_province Location_Province
      ,address_zip_code Location_Zip_Code
      ,address_country Location_Country
      ,address_countryName Location_Country_Name
      ,locationGroup Location_Group
      ,standardHours Standard_Hours
      ,status Status
      ,timezone Time_Zone
	  FROM @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_Location
	)

	 MERGE @{pipeline().parameters.DimSchema}.Dim_Location AS Target
		USING Loc	AS Source
		ON Source.Location_Code = Target.Location_Code
		AND Source.Date_Active_End = Target.Date_Active_End
    
		-- For Inserts
		WHEN NOT MATCHED BY Target THEN  
			INSERT 
           (Location_Code
           ,Date_Active_Start
           ,Date_Active_End
           ,Location_Name
           ,Location_Description
           ,Location_Address1
           ,Location_Address2
           ,Location_City
           ,Location_County
           ,Location_State_Code
           ,Location_State_Name
           ,Location_Province
           ,Location_Zip_Code
           ,Location_Country
           ,Location_Country_Name
           ,Location_Group
           ,Standard_Hours
           ,Status
           ,Time_Zone

DECLARE @GV_Load_Datetime DATETIME2(7) = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS datetime);

WITH Team_Member AS
(
SELECT PERSONNEL_NUMBER Personnel_Number
	 , SUBSTRING(EMPLOYEE_CLASS, 1,10) TeamMember_Class
	 , SUBSTRING(EMPLOYEE_STATUS, 1,10) TeamMember_Status
	 , SUBSTRING(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, 1,10) TeamMember_Type
	 , START_DATE Date_Start
	 , ORIGINAL_START_DATE Date_Start_Original
	 , END_DATE Date_End
	 , NAME_LAST Last_Name
	 , NAME_FIRST First_Name
  FROM @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.STG_SF_COMBINE_WITH_MANAGER
  WHERE PERSONNEL_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
	AND NAME_LAST IS NOT NULL
)

MERGE @{pipeline().parameters.DimSchema}.Dim_Team_Member AS Target
	USING Team_Member AS Source
	ON Source.Personnel_Number = Target.Personnel_Number

	-- For Inserts
	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY Target THEN  
		INSERT 
        (Personnel_Number
        ,Last_Name
        ,First_Name
        ,Date_Start
        ,Date_Start_Original
        ,Date_End
        ,TeamMember_Class
        ,TeamMember_Status
        ,TeamMember_Type
        ,ETL_Source_Id
        ,ETL_Insert_Datetm
        ,ETL_Update_Datetm) 
		VALUES 
		(Source.Personnel_Number
        , Source.Last_Name
        , Source.First_Name
        , Source.Date_Start
        , Source.Date_Start_Original
        , Source.Date_End
        , Source.TeamMember_Class
        , Source.TeamMember_Status
        , Source.TeamMember_Type
		, '33'
		, @GV_Load_Datetime
		, @GV_Load_Datetime)
	    
		-- For Updates  
		WHEN MATCHED 
			AND (Target.TeamMember_Class <> SOURCE.TeamMember_Class 
			OR Target.TeamMember_Status <> SOURCE.TeamMember_Status 
			OR Target.TeamMember_Type <> SOURCE.TeamMember_Type
			OR Target.Date_Start <> SOURCE.Date_Start
			OR Target.Date_Start_Original <> SOURCE.Date_Start_Original
			OR Target.Date_End <> SOURCE.Date_End
			OR Target.Last_Name <> SOURCE.Last_Name
			OR Target.First_Name <> SOURCE.First_Name)
			THEN UPDATE SET
			Target.TeamMember_Class = SOURCE.TeamMember_Class,
			Target.TeamMember_Status = SOURCE.TeamMember_Status,
			Target.TeamMember_Type = SOURCE.TeamMember_Type,
			Target.Date_Start = SOURCE.Date_Start,
			Target.Date_Start_Original = SOURCE.Date_Start_Original,
			Target.Date_End = SOURCE.Date_End,
			Target.Last_Name = SOURCE.Last_Name,
			Target.First_Name = SOURCE.First_Name,
			Target.ETL_Update_DateTm = @GV_Load_Datetime;

DECLARE @GV_Load_Datetime DATETIME2(7) = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS datetime);

WITH Team_Member AS
(
SELECT PERSONNEL_NUMBER [Personnel No#]
	 , SUBSTRING(NAME_FIRST + ' ' + NAME_LAST, 0, 255) [Personnel Number]
	 , EMPLOYEE_CLASS EEGrp
	 , pl.PickListV2_Label [Name of Employee Group]
	 , BUSINESS_AREA [Business Area]
	 , BUSINESS_AREA Name
  FROM @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.STG_SF_COMBINE_WITH_MANAGER e
  LEFT JOIN @{pipeline().parameters.StagingSchema}.Stg_SF_PickListValueV2 pl ON e.EMPLOYEE_CLASS = pl.externalCode
	AND pl.PickListV2_Id = 'EmployeeClass'
	AND pl.status = 'A'
  WHERE PERSONNEL_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
	AND NAME_LAST IS NOT NULL
)

MERGE @{pipeline().parameters.DimSchema}.SAP_TeamMembers_EEGrp AS Target
	USING Team_Member AS Source
	ON Source.[Personnel No#] = Target.[Personnel No#]

	-- For Inserts
	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY Target THEN  
		INSERT 
        ([Personnel No#]
        ,[Personnel Number]
        ,EEGrp
        ,[Name of Employee Group]
        ,[Business Area]
        ,Name) 
		VALUES 
		(Source.[Personnel No#]
        , Source.[Personnel Number]
        , Source.EEGrp
        , Source.[Name of Employee Group]
        , Source.[Business Area]
        , Source.Name)
	    
		-- For Updates  
		WHEN MATCHED 
			AND (Target.[Personnel Number] <> SOURCE.[Personnel Number] 
			OR Target.EEGrp <> SOURCE.EEGrp 
			OR Target.[Name of Employee Group] <> SOURCE.[Name of Employee Group]
			OR Target.[Business Area] <> SOURCE.[Business Area]
			OR Target.Name <> SOURCE.Name)
			THEN UPDATE SET
			Target.[Personnel Number] = SOURCE.[Personnel Number],
			Target.EEGrp = SOURCE.EEGrp,
			Target.[Name of Employee Group] = SOURCE.[Name of Employee Group],
			Target.[Business Area] = SOURCE.[Business Area],
			Target.Name = SOURCE.Name;
